races.race_name: Sky Bet Lowther Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies) (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Moonrise
runners.spotlight: Won on debut (6f, AW) and went close at 66-1 in Listed Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm), before winning the Group 3 Princess Margaret there (6f, good to firm); it was a tight finish last time and further improvement is needed, but she's in good hands to continue to progress; chance.
runners.comment: Won Group 3 Princess Margaret Stakes at Ascot last time and she's in with a chance

runners.name: Wild Blossom
runners.spotlight: All three starts over 5f; won by 10l on debut at Carlisle in May (good, good to soft in places) and, although she was a touch underwhelming in the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot (good to firm), she won a quality conditions race at Glorious Goodwood (good to firm) three weeks ago; having drawn clear close home last time there is every chance that 6f will suit; contender.
runners.comment: Two wins from her three starts (all at 5f), the latest at Glorious Goodwood; contender

runners.name: Libertango
runners.spotlight: 400,000gns breeze-up buy who made it 2-2 when coming from a tough position to win the Group 3 Albany at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm); close second in the Group 2 Duchess Of Cambridge at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) since and the third was a convincing Listed winner next time; leading claims.
runners.comment: Won the Albany and close second in the Duchess Of Cambridge; leading claims

runners.name: Star Of State
runners.spotlight: Inexperience evident when runner-up to Livenka on last month's debut at Fairyhouse (6f, good) and showed the benefit of that experience when easily justifying 1-3 odds in Leopardstown maiden (6.5f, good) eight days later; it's possible she didn't beat much last time but she was certainly impressive, and has been supplemented for this race at a cost of £20,000; dam was a 2yo Group 3 winner; she's one to be interested in.
runners.comment: Impressive at Leopardstown on second start; supplemented for this for £20,000; player

runners.name: Crownbreaker
runners.spotlight: Kept on well for fifth in a strong running of the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) and got off the mark at the fourth attempt in Listed race at Deauville (5f, good to soft) last month, with a next-time-out Listed winner in second; a line can be put through her run in the Molecomb at Goodwood as she stumbled; looks a good prospect for 6f and is one to consider.
runners.comment: 5f French Listed winner; a line can be put through her Molecomb run; she's one to consider

runners.name: Shimmering Sun
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Salisbury (5f, good) in May and kept on well for seventh in the Group 2 Queen Mary at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm), a race that has worked out extremely well; again finished strongly when Listed runner-up to Big Negotiator at Naas (5f, good) four weeks ago and this first crack at 6f could be right up her street; firmly in calculations.
runners.comment: Creditable 5f Group 2/Listed efforts; this first crack at 6f could be right up her street

runners.name: Bint Archange
runners.spotlight: All five starts at 5f; won at Ascot (good) on second outing and bounced back from heavy Royal Ascot defeat with Listed win at Sandown (good) under Ryan Moore, who is back on board today; didn't run up to her best in the Super Sprint at Newbury and now tackles 6f; others appeal more.
runners.comment: 5f Listed win at Sandown then unplaced in the Super Sprint; others appeal more

runners.name: Big Negotiator
runners.spotlight: Her six starts have yielded two wins, in a 5f novice here (good) in June and a 5f Listed race at Naas (good) four weeks ago when showing improved form in a first-time visor (retained) to make virtually all from Shimmering Sun; ran well over 6.2f in May; this Irish challenger could be a factor.
runners.comment: Improved form in this visor for 5f Listed win at Naas; she could be a factor

runners.name: Jolivette
runners.spotlight: Won debut at Newmarket (6f, good) in May and respectable runs in Group races since, finishing ninth in the Albany at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm) then fifth in the Duchess Of Cambridge at Newmarket (6f, good to firm), both times behind Libertango; improvement possible but she has to settle better.
runners.comment: Won on debut at Newmarket; respectable runs in Group races since; has to settle better

runners.name: Livenka
runners.spotlight: Won Fairyhouse maiden (6f, good) last month on third start and comfortably followed up to scoop a valuable pot at Naas (6f, good), making most each time; she's a half-sister to connections' 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Babouche, among others, and could have a big part to play.
runners.comment: Scooped valuable pot at Naas; half-sister to connections' 6f 2yo Group 1 winner Babouche

runners.name: Love A Giggle
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-2 when leading in the final strides in the Listed Marygate Stakes here (5f, good) in May; hasn't kicked on since, however, finishing down the field at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) and merely fourth on recent nursery debut at Newmarket (6f, good to firm); others are preferred.
runners.comment: Made it 2-2 with Listed win here in May but hasn't kicked on since

runners.name: Alta Regina
runners.spotlight: 240,000gns breeze-up buy who won easily on debut at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) and kept on well for sixth of 27 in a hot renewal of the Group 2 Queen Mary at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm); disappointing in the Group 3 Princess Margaret at Ascot (6f, good to firm) last month but she started awkwardly and is better than that; retains potential at 6f; could bounce back.
runners.comment: Kept on well for 6th in 5f Queen Mary; retains potential despite Princess Margaret defeat

runners.name: Miss Kodi
runners.spotlight: Impressive on debut at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) in June and not beaten far when fifth to Moonrise in the Group 3 Princess Margaret at Ascot (6f, good to firm); improvement is needed but she didn't look the finished article last time, having failed to settle and flashed her tail; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Impressive on debut then close fifth in Group 3, when not looking the finished article

runners.name: Ruby Moon
runners.spotlight: Her dam is from a classy family and this filly posted a cosy win on debut at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) in June; beaten about 2l by runner-up Libertango when fourth in Group 2 Duchess Of Cambridge Stakes at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) last month but that was a very creditable performance on just her second start and her powerful finish hinted that a stronger early gallop would have been favourable; not discounted.
runners.comment: Very creditable fourth in Newmarket Group 2 on second start and could take a step forward

runners.name: Angels Passing
runners.spotlight: Thrown in at the deep end on debut in the Listed Marygate here (5f, good) in May and did very well to finish fourth; easily made all at 11-10 in three-runner maiden at Hamilton (6f, good) in June; off since and up in grade today but it remains to be seen where the ceiling of her ability lies.
runners.comment: Listed 4th here on debut and won at Hamilton; it remains to be seen where her ceiling lies

runners.name: In The Black
runners.spotlight: 320,000gns yearling who has an attractive pedigree and is a close relation to 6f Group 2 winner El Caballo; weak in the betting but won four-runner maiden at 13-2 on debut at Carlisle (5f, good to firm) in June; wind op since; takes on a vastly better calibre of opponent this afternoon but she's very unexposed and could be an exciting prospect; no surprise to see a big run.
runners.comment: Defied market weakness to win on debut at Carlisle; could be an exciting prospect

runners.name: Sexy Chick
runners.spotlight: Won Newmarket novice (6f, good to firm) last month on third start and midfield in Listed race at Newbury (5f, good to firm) last Friday; the return to 6f can help but it seems likely her limitations will again be exposed.
runners.comment: Midfield in recent 5f Listed race; return to 6f a plus but limitations set to be exposed

runners.name: Crystal Queen
runners.spotlight: All three runs at 5f on good to firm; won the Hilary Needler at Beverley in May on her second start then mid-division in the Queen Mary at Royal Ascot behind a few of these; the step up to 6f could suit but lots of improvement is needed.
runners.comment: Mid-division at Royal Ascot; step up to 6f could suit but lots of improvement is needed

runners.name: Desert Sands
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability but she's 0-4 and yet to pose a serious threat, including when 250-1 at Royal Ascot; she would be a shock winner today.
runners.comment: Has ability but 0-4 and yet to pose a serious threat, including when 250-1 at Royal Ascot

races.race_name: Harry's Half Million By Goffs (GBB Race)

runners.name: Sun Goddess
runners.spotlight: Only just denied on debut and impressed with 5l win on second start; well backed when a close second in the Albany at Royal Ascot and was then a snug odds-on winner of Curragh Group 2 eight days later; took it up another notch with convincing win in Group 1 Phoenix Stakes at the Curragh (6f, good to firm) 11 days ago; 7lb penalty and she's out fairly quickly again but she sets a high bar.
runners.comment: Won Gr1 (6f, good to firm) 11 days ago; has backed up quickly before; sets a big standard

runners.name: Tokaido
runners.spotlight: Improving gelding who won his second Group race when taking three-runner Group 2 Prix Robert Papin at Chantilly (6f, good) one month ago; shoulders a 7lb penalty but he may be capable of better again and rates a leading contender.
runners.comment: Won second Group race in the Group 2 Robert Papin latest; leading contender under penalty

runners.name: Glorious Game
runners.spotlight: Tongue tied all starts; won her first two, including when she shared a Newmarket Listed event (6f, good to firm) in June; not so good last time and she has a 5lb penalty.
runners.comment: Shared Listed event (6f, good to firm) in June; not so good last time; 5lb penalty

runners.name: Vollering
runners.spotlight: Redcar novice winner on her debut in April who was less than 2l behind Tokaido in Chantilly Listed event (good) the following month; big run when second in another French Listed race (again 5f) 12 days ago; should stay 6f on pedigree and has solid each-way claims on that latter form.
runners.comment: Less than 2l behind Tokaido in May Listed event; big run latest; should stay 6f; solid e-w

runners.name: Where Love Lives
runners.spotlight: Similar form to his debut win when picking up a Sandown Listed event (5f, good; gets a 5lb penalty here) for Kevin Ryan in May; bettered those efforts when fourth of ten in Group 2 Richmond at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good to firm) on his stable debut three weeks ago; left the impression he was capable of better that day and he holds a future Group 1 entry; considered.
runners.comment: 5lb penalty for Listed win; fourth in Gr2 on yard debut latest; could be capable of better

runners.name: Weekend Roar
runners.spotlight: Did just enough to score at Newmarket (good to firm; solid form) on his second start and it wasn't a bad effort when fourth in valuable Naas event (also 6f, good) 17 days ago; needs more, though.
runners.comment: Did just enough to score on his second start; not bad last time but needs more

runners.name: Innichen
runners.spotlight: Improver; picked up a 5f Pontefract maiden (good) in April and had no problem with 6f when taking a Nottingham nursery in July; missed the break but still went on to run well when third of 18 in Glorious Goodwood nursery (again 6f, good to firm) four weeks later; holds Group entries and he's likely better than his current mark; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Improver; ran well in a good nursery last time; holds Group-race entries; not ruled out

runners.name: Battle Fever
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt when he came nicely clear close home over 5f at Thirsk (good) 19 days ago; step back up to 6f should be no problem but that bare form needs a big chunk of improvement.
runners.comment: Came nicely clear close home over 5f (good) 19 days ago; plenty to find back at 6f

runners.name: Kodiak Breeze
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut in May to a subsequent Listed winner and made no mistake in big-field Redcar maiden (6f, good) a fortnight later; belied an awkward head carriage to battle back and score under a penalty at Thirsk last time; has work to do on the figures but might surprise a few.
runners.comment: Belied awkward head carriage to battle back latest; work to do but might surprise a few

runners.name: Rollthedicebaby
runners.spotlight: Yard is no stranger to success in this sort of event and she looked on the up when bounding clear in 6f Goodwood maiden (soft) in June; only sixth of nine in a Newmarket nursery 19 days ago, however.
runners.comment: Yard no stranger to sales-race success but she was only sixth in a nursery 19 days ago

runners.name: Quillan
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten colt who was 28-1 when winning on his debut at Redcar in June and showed a good attitude when defying a penalty at Ripon (again 5f, good) one month later; this step up to 6f could unlock more and he might go well for a long way.
runners.comment: Good attitude when defying a penalty (5f, good) latest; step up to 6f could unlock more
runners.owner: Mrs Anne Atkinson And H D Atkinson

runners.name: Furturra
runners.spotlight: Experienced juvenile who has won two of his ten starts, including a Class 2 seller at Musselburgh (5f, good) in June which leaves him with a 5lb penalty; passed over.
runners.comment: Class 2 selling win at Musselburgh in June leaves him with a 5lb penalty; passed over

runners.name: Satellite Of Love
runners.spotlight: Made all in 12-runner Windsor maiden on his introduction in May and followed up under a penalty at Newbury (again 6f, good to firm) last month; jockey bookings suggest he's the pick of a three-pronged attack from a yard that's won this race for the last three years; respected.
runners.comment: 2-2; jockey bookings suggest he's the pick of 3 from a yard that's on a four-timer in this
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Xvii & M Parker

runners.name: Speed Of Sound
runners.spotlight: All starts at 6f on good to firm and she's displayed similar ability across the three of them, latterly off the mark by a head at Yarmouth a fortnight ago; requires a step up.
runners.comment: Similar ability all starts at 6f and off the mark by a head last time; requires a step up

runners.name: Pride Of Toledo
runners.spotlight: Big step up from his debut when he scampered clear to win four-runner Salisbury novice (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; needs to improve again but it's highly unlikely we've seen the best of him and he's respected as one of three for a yard that's on a four-timer in this race.
runners.comment: Won 6f novice well latest; needs improvement but yard has won last 3 runnings; respected

runners.name: Mind Those Steps
runners.spotlight: Built on his debut to take a Class 2 novice narrowly at Hamilton (6f, good) in May; 5lb penalty for that win makes life even harder and he was down the field in a tongue-tie at Newcastle four weeks ago.
runners.comment: Class 2 novice win at Hamilton (6f, good) in May ensures a 5lb penalty; down the list

runners.name: The Bookkeeper
runners.spotlight: Carries a 3lb penalty for winning Class 3 Haydock novice (good to soft) in May; solid effort when third in Glorious Goodwood nursery (again 7f, good to firm) last time but that still leaves him a little short of the required standard on this drop back to 6f.
runners.comment: 3lb penalty for C3 win in May; solid h'cap run (again 7f) last time still leaves him short

runners.name: It Dunt Marra
runners.spotlight: All starts at 5f; appeared to run quite well when sixth in Sandown Listed event (good) last month and he didn't need to better that effort when opening his account at Lingfield (good to firm) three weeks later; this is a very different test.
runners.comment: Opened account at Lingfield (good to firm) four weeks ago; this is a very different test

runners.name: Niewiadoma
runners.spotlight: All starts at 5f; she made the perfect start at Thirsk (good) in April but it's been downhill in better events subsequently; steps up to 6f with blinkers added.
runners.comment: Perfect start but downhill in better events subsequently; tries 6f with blinkers added

runners.name: Thebesthasyetocome
runners.spotlight: Well-held third behind Where Love Lives on debut at Thirsk (5f, good) in April; different story over 6f on soft ground when drawing away late to bag Ayr maiden two months ago; has some punchy future entries and, while he might already be looking for further, he's not one to rule out at likely rewarding odds.
runners.comment: Looked to relish 6f on soft ground when drawing away last time; not one to ignore

runners.name: Blake's Monarch
runners.spotlight: First two starts at 6f and he looked to appreciate the drop to 5f when tenth of 21 in Royal Ascot's Norfolk (good to firm) two months ago; has since been gelded and undergone wind surgery.
runners.comment: Appreciated drop to 5f when tenth in Norfolk (good to firm) two months ago; gelded/wind op
runners.owner: The Good Racing Co Ltd & Partners

runners.name: Secret Society
runners.spotlight: Stepped forward from his debut to be third of 12 at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month; plenty to do on that bare form but his yard's record in this race ensures he's not instantly dismissed and Dylan Browne McMonagle is an eye-catching jockey booking.
runners.comment: Plenty to do on bare form but yard's record in this ensures he's not instantly dismissed

races.race_name: Sir Kevin Sinfield 7 In 7 Grand Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap)

runners.name: The Lost King
runners.spotlight: Added to his two AW wins early this year when scoring over C&D (good to firm) last month; 6lb higher in hotter race today but this lightly raced 4yo is progressive; unraced on slow turf but dam's family excelled on it.
runners.comment: Lightly raced and progressive 4yo who won over C&D last month; unraced on slow turf

runners.name: Eternal Force
runners.spotlight: Looked very much one to follow after winning his final three runs last term (1m, good to firm/good to soft); that hasn't been the case but he was beaten just a nose at Hamilton (1m, good) two starts ago and perhaps the first-time blinkers will prompt a bigger performance; unproven on soft/heavy.
runners.comment: Won final three runs last season; hasn't built on that this term but new blinkers may help

runners.name: Mezcala
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who reappeared with a win in the Spring Mile at Newbury (1m, good to soft; unraced on softer) and won the Buckingham Palace at Royal Ascot (7f, good to firm) in June; below best in the International at Ascot (7f, good to firm) since but still of interest judged on previous exploits.
runners.comment: Won Royal Ascot h'cap; below best there since but still of interest on previous exploits

runners.name: Aalto
runners.spotlight: His best form has come over 7f on Newmarket's July course (won the Bunbury Cup over that C&D two starts back) but he kept on well when third of 16 in the International at Ascot (7f, good to firm) last time and is worth another crack at 1m; has shown the odd hint of promise at York (including on good to soft ground; unproven on softer); not ruled out.
runners.comment: He's been in good form over 7f and is worth another crack at 1m; not ruled out

runners.name: Cerulean Bay
runners.spotlight: Uncharacteristically below par at Ascot recently but was under a new rider in the Shergar Cup; he's run really well in defeat under Danny Tudhope in some hot handicaps this year and was second in this last season (good to firm); versatile ground-wise; could bounce back with a big performance.
runners.comment: Below par at Ascot but some big runs this year; 2nd in this last August; could bounce back

runners.name: Blue Brother
runners.spotlight: Returned from a year off with fine fourth in the Buckingham Palace at Royal Ascot (7f, good to firm); not quite at the same level in the Golden Mile at Glorious Goodwood (good to firm) since and could do with settling better, but he was effective over 1m in France (including on testing ground) and is capable of playing a leading role if at the top of his game.
runners.comment: Only 8th in Golden Mile but fine 4th at Royal Ascot previously; has won on testing ground

runners.name: Nizam
runners.spotlight: His three French wins came on slow ground; unplaced this year on his three British starts but best effort came on good to soft when 4l seventh of 18 at Epsom in June when squeezed for room more than once; edging down the weights and slow ground would be a major boost to his claims.
runners.comment: Unplaced on his three British starts but rain would be a major boost to his claims

runners.name: Yorkshire
runners.spotlight: Returned to form when going very close at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month and again ran well when third of 13 at Haydock (1m, good) 12 days ago; it's possible he's better over 7f but he might not be far away; has won on good to soft, unraced on softer.
runners.comment: Went very close over 7f at Doncaster then third over 1m at Haydock; might not be far away

runners.name: Spell Master
runners.spotlight: Close third at Newmarket (good) in June when upped to 1m on his second start for this yard, and he made good headway before his run petered out in the John Smith's Cup here (10.2f, good to firm) last month; denied a clear run when mid-division at Glorious Goodwood (1m1f, good to firm) last time; the return to 1m could be ideal; ran well on soft early in career; chance.
runners.comment: Eye-catching headway in 10.2f John Smith's Cup here before run petered out; chance

runners.name: Bullet Point
runners.spotlight: Failed to kick on after winning this last year (good to firm) but he returned to form in first-time cheekpieces (retained today) when runner-up at Ascot (1m, good to firm) recently; won on soft ground early in career; firmly in the mix if backing up that latest performance.
runners.comment: Last year's winner who returned to form when second at Ascot recently; in the mix

runners.name: Centigrade
runners.spotlight: Looked very promising in 2024 on first two starts (7f/1m, good/heavy) and returned from long absence to win a Southwell novice (1m, AW) at 6-4 two months ago; in a hot race on a lofty mark for his handicap debut but very unexposed and could well be up to the task for his top yard.
runners.comment: Returned from long absence with AW novice win; very unexposed; could be up to the task

runners.name: Checkandchallenge
runners.spotlight: 7yo who is winless since November 2023 but has dropped down the weights and was 4l third of 13 to The Lost King over C&D (good to firm) last month; each-way claims if acting on the ground; his last win came on heavy going but subsequent slow-ground form has been mixed.
runners.comment: 7yo whose losing run continues but he was third over C&D last month off a reduced mark

runners.name: The Angel King
runners.spotlight: Two wins in France last year over 7f on very soft/good to soft; mixed form for new yard this year but has twice run well at Chester, most recently second there 18 days ago (7f, good); 1m might be within range and he has possibilities if backing up that latest performance.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Chester 18 days ago and has possibilities if backing up that performance

runners.name: Arctic Dawn
runners.spotlight: Made it four wins from his last ten starts when scoring at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) recently; on a lofty mark under a 6lb penalty and it remains to be seen if he's just as good over 1m, but there can be optimism in that regard and he's clearly progressive; has run well on soft/good to soft.
runners.comment: On a lofty mark under 6lb penalty but he's won four of his last ten; clearly progressive

runners.name: Hawksbill
runners.spotlight: Two quick runs at Glorious Goodwood three weeks ago, beaten only 2l when fifth of 20 on the Wednesday (7f, good to firm) then seventh of 18 in the Golden Mile on the Friday (good to firm) when he would have been closer with a clear run; it's possible he'll be involved; unproven on slow ground.
runners.comment: Two positive performances at Glorious Goodwood three weeks ago; unproven on slow ground

runners.name: Mirsky
runners.spotlight: Two wins last year (1m, good to firm/good to soft; he's possibly okay on soft) and added another off this mark at Thirsk (1m, good to firm) in May; however, he's finished no better than seventh across his five runs since.
runners.comment: Won off this mark at Thirsk in May but he hasn't really shone since

runners.name: Point Lynas
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who has an extremely solid record in C&D handicaps and was fourth of 18 over C&D (good) in May; Listed runner-up at Pontefract (1m, good to firm) since; capable of a bold bid if conditions suit; there would be a question mark about him on slow ground.
runners.comment: Extremely solid record in C&D handicaps; there would be a question mark on slow ground
runners.owner: Julie And David R Martin And Dan Hall

runners.name: Kalpana
runners.spotlight: Poetry in motion up the straight at Ascot where's she registered all three of her Group 1 wins, on a range of ground, crowned by the King George (1m4f, good to firm) last month; unraced here but also shone at Newbury on 2026 reappearance; as today's chief rival on ratings is Minnie Hauk, who finished well adrift of her in the King George, this mare is the one to beat.
runners.comment: Three 1m4f Group 1 wins at Ascot, crowned by the King George last month; the one to beat

runners.name: Minnie Hauk
runners.spotlight: 1m4f Group 1 wins last summer in the Oaks, Irish Oaks and Yorkshire Oaks before she was beaten a head in the Arc de Triomphe at Longchamp; creditable runner-up to top-class Ombudsman at Royal Ascot this June but disappointing either side of that and well adrift of Kalpana in the King George at Ascot last time; can go head to head with Kalpana if back to her best.
runners.comment: One of 2025's stars (won this); Royal Ascot 2nd this term but well adrift in King George
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Earth Shot
runners.spotlight: Second on soft ground in her only 2yo race; vastly better form on good/good to firm this season, most notably when catching Johanna Walsh on the line in Group 2 Ribblesdale at Royal Ascot; the placings were reversed big time in the Irish Oaks (again 1m4f on good to firm) one month later, which wasn't her true running but she now needs to resume progress and in a major way.
runners.comment: Pipped Johanna Walsh at Royal Ascot but flopped behind her in the Irish Oaks

runners.name: Johanna Walsh
runners.spotlight: Third in a soft-ground maiden on reappearance; huge advances in her three starts since, notably when pipped by Earth Shot at Royal Ascot and 4l winner of Irish Oaks at the Curragh (both 1m4f on good to firm); the latter was in smooth style, as she skipped clear over 1f out before Inis Mor ran on into second, while Earth Shot disappointed in sixth; any further improvement would make her a serious rival for the older stars in this race.
runners.comment: Pipped by Earth Shot at Royal Ascot before smooth 4l winner of Irish Oaks at the Curragh

runners.name: Legacy Link
runners.spotlight: Won the Group 3 Musidora here (10.2f, good) in May and a clear second in the Oaks at Epsom (1m4f, good to soft) in June, albeit no match for the winning stablemate of Johanna Walsh; favourite for the Ribblesdale at Royal Ascot (good to firm) but already no answers when hampered over 1f out; she'd be far from the first to find that race coming too soon after the Oaks and could bounce back, but today's task requires a huge career best.
runners.comment: Oaks 2nd; could bounce back from Ribblesdale flop but this requires a huge career best

runners.name: Sparan Nua
runners.spotlight: Unraced on worse than good to yielding; won first three races, notably a 1m4f Group 3 at Cork in June; had to be switched 2f out in Irish Oaks at the Curragh (1m4f, good to firm) next time, keeping fairly close tabs on Inis Mor thereafter as both came from well off the pace to be placed, but Johanna Walsh had gone well beyond recall; while that might have promised better still, she needs to leave this month's flop at Leopardstown way behind her.
runners.comment: While Irish Oaks third might have promised better still, this month's run was a flop

runners.name: Inis Mor
runners.spotlight: Ran well on soft as 2yo, confined to good or good to firm this season; beat Earth Shot by a head in Listed race at Goodwood in May, which preceded fine Group 1 placed efforts in the 10.4f Prix de Diane at Chantilly and 1m4f Irish Oaks at the Curragh; saw out the 1m4f well but Johanna Walsh was 4l ahead.
runners.comment: Group 1 placed efforts on last two starts but Johanna Walsh was 4l ahead in the Irish Oaks

runners.name: Tattycoram
runners.spotlight: Progressive 3yo on varied ground last season who won a Listed race at Goodwood (1m4f, good) in May on her 2026 reappearance; it was a revelation, though, when she responded so well to sustained pressure to assert by four and a half lengths in the Group 2 Lancashire Oaks at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) early last month; problem today is that the Group 1 Yorkshire version includes much more daunting opposition.
runners.comment: Revelation to win Group 2 Lancashire Oaks so well but the Yorkshire version demands more

runners.name: Sugar Island
runners.spotlight: 2yo Group 3 winner on heavy who was 6l behind Legacy Link when third in the Oaks at Epsom (1m4f, good to soft) this June; tailed off when 20-1 in Irish Oaks (made most) last time, which was her first run both on good to firm and in cheekpieces; likely to have neither of those today but she is comfortably bottom of this pack on ratings; could have front-running duties.
runners.comment: 6l behind Legacy Link when third in the Oaks; tailed off in the Irish Oaks (made most)
runners.owner: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith

races.race_name: British EBF & Sir Henry Cecil Galtres Stakes (Listed Race) (Fillies & Mares) (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Morrophore
runners.spotlight: Tail flasher who has looked a bit tricky at times but she's also won four of her eight starts; did it well in a handicap at Ascot (good to firm) in May 2025 and, with Ryan Moore taking over, she then justified short-priced favouritism in last-gasp fashion in two hot AW handicaps at Lingfield last winter; those wins were 1m2f and she's unraced beyond that, but three siblings scored at 1m3f or 1m4f; absent since January but those last two 1m2f AW wins make her the clear form pick.
runners.comment: Absent since January but last winter's two 1m2f AW wins make her the clear form pick

runners.name: Prizeland
runners.spotlight: Sister to 2022 Derby second Hoo Ya Mal; dual AW novice winner (1m/1m4f); runner-up in the Lingfield Oaks Trial (11.6f, good to firm) before fifth of 15 in the Italian Oaks (10.5f, good) and second to an impressive winner in Listed race at Hamilton (1m3f, good to firm), which were all useful form but she'll need to find a bit extra.
runners.comment: Last three starts (up to 11.6f) were all useful form but she'll need to find a bit extra

runners.name: Rhapsody
runners.spotlight: Won debut on good to soft, no impression in her one race on soft; 1m1f handicap winner here last September and, having finished well for fourth of 24 over 1m this season at Royal Ascot, she ran on into second of eight when trying 1m2f again in Group 3 at the Curragh on latest outing; races a bit freely but her dam was pretty useful at this trip; each-way form chance.
runners.comment: Moves up in trip and races a bit freely but her dam was pretty useful at 1m4f

runners.name: Vauntingly
runners.spotlight: Clearcut win from the front in a maiden at Killarney (11.3f, good) in her fourth race, having been second on soft the time before; came from midfield when short-headed by a stablemate in seven-runner Listed race at Gowran Park (1m4f, good; the third won a Group 3 next time) last month, producing another improved effort and making her a big player in these calculations.
runners.comment: Short-headed in Listed race at Gowran Park (1m4f, good) latest; big player

runners.name: Summerson
runners.spotlight: Hooded on all three starts; kicked off this summer with two seconds, on the strength of which she was 11-10 favourite at Ffos Las (1m4f, good) late last month in another maiden, which she proceeded to win by 13l after leading over 1f out; only four ran in that steadily run race and this is a very different proposition, but she strode clear in great style and looks useful.
runners.comment: Four ran in steadily run Ffos Las maiden (1m4f, good) but she strode clear in great style

runners.name: Ashariba
runners.spotlight: Made most for Listed win at Saint-Cloud last October and reappeared this May with a respectable Listed second in France, both 1m2f on soft; won over 1m3f in 2024 and she now looks worth a crack at 1m4f; first, though, she needs to bounce back after tailing off in an AW Group 3 (20-1) eight weeks ago.
runners.comment: Worth a crack at 1m4f but needs to bounce back after tailing off in an AW Group 3

runners.name: A La Prochaine
runners.spotlight: Won at Newbury (1m, soft) on sole 2yo start and beaten about 3l in the Listed Cheshire Oaks at Chester (11.3f, good) on return; 22-1, stuck to her task well for a never-dangerous, 10l fourth of nine in the Oaks at Epsom (1m4f, good to soft) 11 weeks ago; off since but could have more improvement in her and 1m4f on rain-softened ground would seemingly hold no fears.
runners.comment: 22-1, stuck to task well for 10l fourth of nine in the Oaks at Epsom (1m4f, good to soft)

runners.name: Without Prejudice
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to high-class middle-distance performer Emily Upjohn; weak 3-1 for debut in four-runner novice at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago and showed inexperience under pressure, but she looked classy in striding clear from a maiden winner; no shock if she proves up to this level at some point; whether it's on just her second start is the chief question.
runners.comment: Looked classy when winning a four-runner Newmarket novice (1m2f, good to firm) last month

runners.name: Capichera
runners.spotlight: Long odds-on for her Pontefract novice win (1m, good; acts on good to soft) in June; close third of seven when 5-6 for a handicap at Windsor one month ago on the move up to 1m2f and she's by Australia, which boosts hopes for 1m4f; she has the lowest rating in this field, however.
runners.comment: Her sire boosts hopes for 1m4f but she has the lowest rating in this field

runners.name: K Sarra
runners.spotlight: Sister to connections' Pride Of Arras, last year's Dante and Great Voltigeur winner at this track; this filly's best effort has likewise been at York, when third in the Group 3 Musidora (10.2f, good) in May; however, tailing off in the Oaks at Epsom (good to soft; 18-1) and seventh of nine in Listed race at Newmarket, both 1m4f, weaken her case considerably; headgear is now enlisted.
runners.comment: Third in the Musidora here but tailed off in the Oaks and seventh of nine in a Listed race

runners.name: Sunshine Star
runners.spotlight: Sea The Stars half-sister to the same connections' Oaks winner Soul Sister; unraced on softer than good; easily off the mark at the third attempt (1m2f, AW); second in a handicap at Windsor (1m2f) and fourth of eight from the back in Listed race at Newmarket (1m4f, again good to firm) maintained her upward curve, giving her similar form claims to most of these.
runners.comment: 4th of eight in Listed race at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) maintained her upward curve

runners.name: Perfect Your Craft
runners.spotlight: 3-6 for Ralph Beckett, including a 1m4f handicap win at Newmarket last October on good ground (previous wins were on heavy and good to soft); similar form this season in Ireland over 1m2f, 1m4f and 1m6f for new yard, without a win but the last two of those assignments were Group 3 (with cheekpieces enlisted) and she has a similar form chance to most in this line-up.
runners.comment: More useful form this season in Ireland over 1m2f, 1m4f and 1m6f for new yard

runners.name: Ryka
runners.spotlight: Showed she stays 1m4f well in two races on good to soft last autumn, latterly with a clearcut Listed win at Toulouse; well below form in her only start this season (start of May) but interesting if she's back on song.
runners.comment: Well below form in sole start this season (May) but interesting if she's back on song

runners.name: Club Class
runners.spotlight: Second off handicap marks of 79 and 81 this summer, so filling the same position in nine-runner Listed race at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) on latest outing was the first inkling that she might be able to hold her own at this level; wore cheekpieces on last two starts.
runners.comment: 2nd off marks of 79 and 81 before 2nd of 9 in Newmarket Listed race (1m4f, good to firm)

runners.name: Merveilleux Lapin
runners.spotlight: Ex-Polish filly who has won on soft; minor honours this term over 1m2f in handicap at Windsor (unlucky) and over 1m4f in both a Listed event at Pontefract (fourth of nine) and handicap at Ascot; needs to find a bit extra but has similar form to most in this field.
runners.comment: Running creditably; needs to find a bit extra but has similar form to most in this field

races.race_name: Mews Hotel Ossett EBF Stallions Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Shadow King
runners.spotlight: Second success when getting up close home on nursery debut at Doncaster (extended 6f; good to firm; first-time blinkers); excuses when only midfield in a 7f Glorious Goodwood nursery the following week; his mark still looks favourable on the Doncaster form and his stable won this two years ago.
runners.comment: Won on nursery debut and excuses at Goodwood since; yard won this in 2024
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Rising Tiger
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on all three starts; had Mia Fantasia in third at Ascot (7f, good to firm) on the second occasion and narrowly denied by Roosike at Southwell (7f, AW; now meets that rival on identical terms) last time; stall 21 could be tricky but Andrew Balding's excellent record in this race (three wins since 2021, including last year) makes him a must for the shortlist.
runners.comment: Wide draw but yard's excellent record in this (three wins) makes him a must for shortlist

runners.name: Mirzimaan
runners.spotlight: Has raced just at 6f; too green on debut but took a significant step forward with his defeat of 17 rivals at Newbury (good to firm) last month; bettered that form and would have won with a clearer passage when only just failing to get up at Newcastle (AW) since; should have more to offer now moving up to 7f for his nursery debut but Billy Loughnane seemingly prefers stablemate Perfect Nation.
runners.comment: Open to further progress now up to 7f for nursery debut but Loughnane rides his stablemate

runners.name: High Calibre
runners.spotlight: Advanced his form again when second of five on 1m Newmarket nursery debut (good to firm) a fortnight ago; 5lb higher here (including 2lb out of the handicap) so he'll require another chunk of improvement to land a first success.
runners.comment: Going the right way but he's 5lb higher than when second over 1m two weeks ago

runners.name: Weleyff
runners.spotlight: Progressing well, winning five-runner races (7f, good to firm) for a novice at Ayr and nursery at Doncaster in recent weeks; made all with something to spare at the latter track and a 5lb rise may not prevent another bold bid with the Ed Bethell stable in flying form; engaged in the Group 2 Champagne at Doncaster next month.
runners.comment: On a hat-trick and his yard couldn't be in better form; there are reasons to be positive

runners.name: High Hazard
runners.spotlight: Behind several of these at Glorious Goodwood and first-time cheekpieces need to make a big difference.
runners.comment: Behind some of these at Glorious Goodwood; cheekpieces need to be a big help

runners.name: Mia Fantasia
runners.spotlight: All runs over 7f on good to firm, overcoming a slow start to win comfortably at Carlisle on debut before third to Dr Rascal (Rising Tiger second) in novice at Ascot; on the back of those efforts he went off a hot favourite for a Glorious Goodwood nursery but didn't get the chance to show what he could do, meeting trouble on a couple of occasions and doing well to finish sixth of 18; that performance strongly suggests he can go close at the least off this mark with more luck in running.
runners.comment: Met trouble when 2-1 for Goodwood nursery, doing well to get sixth; worth another chance

runners.name: Koodini
runners.spotlight: Made it sixth time lucky when seeing off three rivals in a 7f Catterick nursery (good to firm) 29 days ago; that was his first attempt at this trip but he's 5lb higher in a significantly stronger race now; also drawn widest.
runners.comment: Breakthrough success in 7f Catterick nursery but this is significantly harder

runners.name: Rbflying
runners.spotlight: His claims aren't obvious having finished well held in nurseries over 6f here (Big Cigar won) and 7f at Goodwood (behind five of these) on his last two starts; tongue tied first time; 3lb out of the handicap.
runners.comment: Behind five of these at Goodwood; first-time tongue-tie needs to spark major improvement

runners.name: Regal Tiger
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who has shown steady improvement over 6f, half-length second (Theheatison fourth) to a next-time-out winner when favourite for Windsor nursery (good to firm) most recently; bred to be suited by this step up in distance; Mia Fantasia looks the pick of the stable's four runners but no surprise were this one to play a prominent role.
runners.comment: Steady progress over 6f and there may be even more to come at 7f; not discounted

runners.name: Caeruleus
runners.spotlight: First three starts over 6f, winning a Newcastle novice on the third; stepped up to 7f for his nursery debut and ran well for fifth (The Ginger Kid second) of 18 at Glorious Goodwood, albeit better positioned than some of today's reopposing rivals who finished behind him.
runners.comment: 6f AW novice win and positive start to nursery career when fifth of 18 at Goodwood (7f)

runners.name: Revels
runners.spotlight: 7f Redcar debut scorer (good) in May; faded out of things in the Chesham at Royal Ascot next time but different proposition with sights lowered when pipping Dubai Champion (non-runner here on Wednesday) in 6f Glorious Goodwood nursery (good to firm); a 5lb rise demands further improvement but Group entries next month point to him being well regarded by his top stable; the draw could have been kinder.
runners.comment: Up 5lb for 6f Glorious Goodwood win but Group entries suggest he's well regarded

runners.name: Telegraphic
runners.spotlight: All starts over 7f on good to firm; took big step forward from debut fourth to Mia Fantasia when easily drawing clear by just over 7l at Brighton last month; backed that up when narrowly denied under a penalty at Yarmouth 18 days ago; looks on a competitive mark for his nursery debut.
runners.comment: Followed easy win at Brighton with close second under penalty; looks on competitive mark

runners.name: Theheatison
runners.spotlight: Bath novice win came over an extended 5f but he looked suited by the return to 7f when never-nearer third of seven in Newmarket nursery (good to firm) 12 days ago; needs to build on that.
runners.comment: Win came over extended 5f but looked suited by 7f when third in Newmarket nursery latest

runners.name: Perfect Nation
runners.spotlight: Won novices at Lingfield (7f, AW) and Ffos Las (extended 7f, good) this summer; the fact he's gone off at 13-8 or shorter on all three starts suggest he's highly thought of by his leading yard, as do Group entries next month; handily drawn and Billy Loughnane is on him rather than stablemate Mirzimaan; interesting.
runners.comment: On hat-trick after pair of novice wins around 7f and he's shortlisted from a handy draw

runners.name: Roosike
runners.spotlight: Beaten a fair way when placed on first two outings and took a good step forward when holding on determinedly from the reopposing Rising Tiger in novice at Southwell (7f, AW) 24 days ago; meets that rival on the same terms.
runners.comment: Held on from Rising Tiger when making it third time lucky at Southwell (7f) last month

runners.name: Bymiddaytomorrow
runners.spotlight: Has improved for a step up to 7f, winning a maiden at Ayr (good to firm) and nursery at Thirsk (good) in recent weeks; further progress possible but it will be needed off this 5lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Winner of maiden and nursery over this trip in recent months but new mark demands more

runners.name: Fasthope
runners.spotlight: Got up close home to make a successful start to his nursery career over 6f at Pontefract (good) 44 days ago and the runner-up gave that form a boost when winning at Lingfield on Monday; the return to 7f may prompt more improvement but he is running off 9lb higher now (including 4lb out of handicap).
runners.comment: Return to 7f is a help after leading late over 6f at Pontefract, but 4lb out of weights

runners.name: My A'Ali Baba
runners.spotlight: Chepstow debut win in the spring came on good to soft, so he wouldn't have any issues should the forecast rain arrive; hasn't built on that significantly but he's one of a few in this line-up who didn't enjoy much luck in running in the Glorious Goodwood nursery over this trip last month and a Listed race was simply too much for him at Salisbury last month.
runners.comment: Hasn't really built on debut win but that came on good to soft, so rain may help

runners.name: Soldier Of The Sea
runners.spotlight: Justified market support with neck success at Ffos Las (6f, good) on debut and backed that up when second under a penalty at Salisbury (6f, good to firm) 30 days ago, keeping on well despite his jockey dropping his whip inside the final furlong; steps up to 7f for his nursery debut; another in the line-up who holds a Group entry next month.
runners.comment: 6f debut scorer and second under penalty since (6f again); up in trip for nursery debut

runners.name: Big Cigar
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-3 when seeing off his seven rivals in 6f nursery here in July; respectable seventh of ten pitched into Group 2 at Goodwood (6f, good to firm again) and the same in Group 3 Acomb here (7f, good; 33-1) on Wednesday.
runners.comment: 6f nursery win here in July; respectable 7th of ten in two Group events, latest yesterday

runners.name: The Ginger Kid
runners.spotlight: Won a 6f novice at Nottingham (good) in early June; failed to fire in the Coventry at Royal Ascot but has bounced back with good seconds in 7f nurseries at Chester and Glorious Goodwood (a few of these rivals behind); didn't look entirely at ease on the course at Goodwood (hung right) and it's possible that this track will suit him better.
runners.comment: Latest Goodwood second can possibly be marked up given he didn't look at ease on the track

runners.name: Machadadorp
runners.spotlight: Unraced on ground slower than good; off the mark in a maiden at Chester (7f) on second start and followed up narrowly in a novice at Wetherby (7f; second has won since); ran well behind an improving rival on handicap debut at Newmarket (7f) last month but was below that level at Goodwood (6f) three weeks ago; stepping back up in trip should suit.
runners.comment: Bumped into an improver on handicap debut but below that level over 6f at Goodwood since

runners.name: Albaydaa
runners.spotlight: Unraced on ground slower than good since her debut; half-sister to Queen Elizabeth ll Jubilee Stakes winner Almeraq; placed on her first two outings this season (6f/7f) before doubling her win tally with a neck success at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) in May; strong in the betting when only fifth in a Listed race there in June, but she now returns to handicap company and should still be capable of progress.
runners.comment: Won a Carlisle handicap in May and fifth there in a Listed race latest; capable of better

runners.name: Secret History
runners.spotlight: Unraced on ground slower than good; off the mark when winning a Chelmsford novice (6f, AW) in January and has since won twice in handicap company with this hood applied, most recently off a steady pace at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last month; solid effort at Goodwood (6f, good; Woohoo was second) last time and she has each-way claims returned to this trip.
runners.comment: Has won twice since the hood went on; solid effort over 6f at Goodwood last time; claims

runners.name: Perfect Part
runners.spotlight: Acts on good to soft but unraced on slower; without a win since her debut in June 2024 (Hilary Needler) but she has posted some good efforts, including when a 1l second of 11 at Thirsk (1m, good) in May; however, she hasn't been at her best in her two starts since and was well beaten in this race last year, albeit off an 11lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Won the 2024 Hilary Needler but without a win since; below her best on last two starts

runners.name: Royal Velvet
runners.spotlight: Well below form on sole start on softer than good; landed this contest last year off a 14lb lower mark and she's improved again this season, winning a competitive handicap at Newmarket (7f) and the Group 3 Chartwell at Lingfield (7f); well held on her next two outings, including in a Royal Ascot handicap, but then produced a solid effort in the Group 3 Oak Tree at Goodwood (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; Conor Whiteley takes off 5lb and she can't be dismissed back in a handicap.
runners.comment: Won this last year; Group 3 winner in May and can't be dismissed back in a handicap

runners.name: Zooella
runners.spotlight: 0-4 as 2yo but improved form since a 207-day break, making all at Lingfield (6f, AW) before following up at Thirsk on her turf debut (6f, good to firm); leaves the impression she has more to offer but now steps back up in trip in a deeper race off this 8lb higher mark (2lb out of the handicap).
runners.comment: Won twice over 6f this year; steps back up in trip in a deeper race off an 8lb higher mark

runners.name: Carnival Of Light
runners.spotlight: Well held over 1m on turf on her first two outings (good) but she posted an improved effort when winning a Wolverhampton maiden (7f, AW) last month; overcame a wide trip to follow up on her handicap debut over that same C&D 20 days ago, holding off the late challenge of the runner-up, but she now needs to transfer that improvement to turf.
runners.comment: Has shown improved form since switching to the AW; now needs to transfer that to turf

runners.name: Just Call Me Angel
runners.spotlight: All three turf wins have been on good ground, including two Group-race successes at San Siro over 1m, most recently in the Italian 1,000 Guineas in May; below her best in three starts since and may be high in the weights for now; drops back to 7f with cheekpieces applied.
runners.comment: Last two wins have been in Group races at San Siro; may be high in the weights

runners.name: Starlight Lass
runners.spotlight: Caught the eye on her debut over 7f (good to soft) before making all in a three-runner novice at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) and following that with a comfortable success in another small field at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) last month; this race is much more competitive but she doesn't lack a turn of foot, which bodes well for this drop back in trip, and this well-related filly is a leading contender on her handicap debut.
runners.comment: Has won two small-field events over 1m and looks a smart prospect; leading contender

runners.name: Figjam
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in a novice at Leicester (6f, good) last October and second behind Lam Yai in a Listed event at Doncaster (6f, heavy) next time; posted her best effort on RPRs when sixth of 13 in Group 3 here over 6f last month but she was below her best in a handicap at Ascot (6f, good to firm) 12 days ago; down 2lb but others look stronger.
runners.comment: Sole win came in a Leicester novice last October; below her best at Ascot (6f) last time

runners.name: Beaujolais Nouveau
runners.spotlight: Probably acts on soft ground; two wins from 18 starts, the most recent win at Ripon (6f, good; first-time cheekpieces) in May off a 5lb lower mark than today's; ran a solid race when fourth of 20 at Goodwood (6f, good) last time but she doesn't look to be crying out for this step back up in trip and her draw could have been kinder.
runners.comment: Solid effort at Goodwood last time but doesn't look to be crying out for the return to 7f

runners.name: Cotai Belle
runners.spotlight: Best form has been on good/good to firm ground; dual winner last year (5.5f/5f) and she's been runner-up in four of her five starts this year, including when going close here in a 0-100 over 6f in June; her pedigree gives the impression this step up in trip will be no problem and she's a contender.
runners.comment: Runner-up in four of her five starts this year; including here over 6f; steps up in trip

runners.name: Oolong Poobong
runners.spotlight: Unraced on ground slower than good; landed a handicap at Haydock (7f) last May in convincing style before a good fourth in the Sandringham (1m); returned from 11 months off with a solid fifth of 13 at Thirsk (1m; first-time tongue-tie) in May but well beaten since in the Kensington Palace back at Royal Ascot (1m); drops back in trip, needing to bounce back.
runners.comment: Solid effort on her reappearance at Thirsk in May but well beaten since at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Bellarchi
runners.spotlight: Acts on most ground; has won three handicaps at Musselburgh this season and gained her first Listed success when scoring at Chester (7f, good) in June, but she was below that level at Pontefract (1m) last month; has a better draw than she did when down the field in this contest last year but is now 11lb higher than when last seen in handicap company.
runners.comment: Has won four times this season; below her best latest; down the field in this last year

runners.name: Caim
runners.spotlight: Comfortable win on her debut at Beverley (7.5f, soft) last September and second of eight in a Newbury Listed race (7f, soft) the following month; disappointed under a penalty on her reappearance at Leicester (1m, good to firm) in May and now makes her handicap debut having been off again since; will appreciate any rain that falls.
runners.comment: Won on debut; disappointing return on good to firm; probably wants ground slower than good
runners.owner: Julie And David R Martin And Dan Hall

runners.name: Woohoo
runners.spotlight: Unproven on ground slower than good to soft; five-time winner (5f/6f), the most recent win at Musselburgh in April off a 10lb lower mark than today's; second in each of her last five starts, including when ahead of a few of today's rivals at Goodwood (6f, good) two starts back, but now tries 7f for the first time off a career-high mark.
runners.comment: Five-time winner (5f/6f); ahead of a few of today's rivals at Goodwood; first go at 7f

runners.name: Mubasimah
runners.spotlight: Unraced on ground softer than good; can front-run; sixth in the Group 3 Nell Gwyn on her reappearance before finishing down the field in the 1,000 Guineas and fading into fifth in a French Group 2 (1m, good; her best form); now drops back to 7f after failing to settle over 1m in the Sandringham at Royal Ascot two months ago but stall 17 isn't ideal.
runners.comment: Faded into fifth in French Group 2 (her best form) and failed to settle last time, both 1m

runners.name: Lam Yai
runners.spotlight: Best efforts have been on soft/heavy ground, including when going close in a Group 3 at Ayr (6f) last September and winning a Listed contest at Doncaster (6f) when last seen 299 days ago; has since had wind surgery and steps up to 7f for her reappearance; pedigree suggests she'll stay but she may need this return to action.
runners.comment: Off since winning a heavy-ground Listed race over 6f last October; has had wind surgery

runners.name: Tryst
runners.spotlight: Unproven on ground slower than good; 3yo filly who seems to have been well suited by dropping back to 7f in cheekpieces, landing a six-runner handicap at Yarmouth (good to firm) and making all at Newmarket (good to firm) 19 days ago; another 6lb higher in this more competitive race but can't be dismissed lightly in her current form.
runners.comment: Has appreciated dropping back to 7f with cheekpieces on; up 6lb since her latest success

runners.name: Starfinch
runners.spotlight: Unraced on ground slower than good; made a winning yard debut in a Southwell novice (6f, AW) in January and built on that when sixth of eight in a Listed event at Lingfield (7f, AW); had failed to beat a rival in two starts on turf prior to finishing a close third of four on handicap debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) four weeks ago, but this is a more competitive contest.
runners.comment: Won on the AW in January; proved she acts on turf when a close third at Yarmouth last time
runners.owner: Mrs Frank Barry & Mrs Luke Barry

runners.name: Bella Lyra
runners.spotlight: Acts on soft-good to firm ground; off the mark when winning at Windsor (6f) on second start and ran well when second of eight in a Listed event at Lingfield (7f, AW) in February; then left Richard Hughes and has since struggled in two starts in the USA (6.5f/1m); now makes her handicap debut on her first start back for this trainer.
runners.comment: Struggled in two starts in USA but now back with her previous stable; handicap debut
runners.owner: Jastar Capital Ltd & Rancho Temescal Thoroughbred Partners

runners.name: Minkaas
runners.spotlight: £140,000 breeze-up 2yo; showed clear promise on Bath debut in May and she built on that when going close over this trip at York (good to firm) two weeks ago; just about sets the standard on that clear third and she should continue to improve with experience; key player.
runners.comment: Stepped up on her promising debut effort when a close third at York; key player

runners.name: Grey Tamam
runners.spotlight: 140,000euros breeze-up 2yo who made a promising start when third at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) last month; finished last of eight at Sandown last time but that was a Listed race and she didn't get home on the step up to 7f; looks interesting back in calmer waters and she's a big player if she can build on her initial form.
runners.comment: Had tough task in a Listed race (7f) last time and she's in the mix back in calmer waters

runners.name: Elpeeare
runners.spotlight: 95,000gns yearling; eye-catching third on Wolverhampton debut (5f, AW) last month and she didn't get much luck when fourth at Sandown (5f, good to firm) 18 days later; that form puts her firmly in the picture and she's open to more progress on this step up in trip; interesting contender.
runners.comment: Two promising efforts over 5f and she's an interesting contender upped in trip

runners.name: Scoot Away
runners.spotlight: 70,000gns yearling; third foal; dam 5f 2yo winner (RPR 92), half-sister to winners Heartache (5f 2yo Group 2), Unbreak My Heart (Group-placed 5f 2yo) and Heartwarming (Listed-placed 5f 2yo), out of 5f Listed winner; tongue-tie is applied on debut and market should guide.
runners.comment: 70,000gns yearling; tongue-tie is applied on debut and market should guide

runners.name: Plastic Dream
runners.spotlight: 35,000gns yearling, 55,000gns breeze-up 2yo; fourth foal; sister to 1m-1m2f winner Phone Tag (including 2yo; RPR 79); dam 1m 2yo winner (75), half-sister to 7.6f/1m winner Drymee, out of French 1m 2yo winning half-sister to useful 1m1f-1m4f winner Demolition; yard 0-6 with 2yos this season and she could be a longer-term prospect.
runners.comment: 55,000gns breeze-up 2yo; yard 0-6 with 2yos this season and she could be one for later on

runners.name: Zephyra
runners.spotlight: Looked inexperienced but she shaped with promise when a 20-1 second on her debut over C&D (good to firm) two weeks ago; that form is not strong but she should know more this time and is open to progress on her second start.
runners.comment: 20-1 second over C&D on recent debut and she should know more this time; not ruled out

races.race_name: Van Buck 50th Anniversary Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Tie A Navyribbon
runners.spotlight: Both runs have been at big prices over 7f (good to firm) on this course; rallied well when third in a novice (third of seven) last month and she wasn't disgraced in the Group 3 Sweet Solera last time; has leading claims now back in much calmer waters and she's out of a 1m winner.
runners.comment: Not disgraced in a Group 3 here last time and she's a big player back in calmer waters

runners.name: Missouri Waltz
runners.spotlight: 95,000gns yearling but re-sold for £20,000 at a breeze-up; half-sister to two useful winners including Zihba (7f/1m including Group 3; RPR 104); 11-2 on Catterick debut (7f, good to firm) last month and she found plenty before staying on strongly to beat nine rivals; this is tougher under a penalty but that was a bright start and she's open to progress upped in trip.
runners.comment: Made a bright start when scoring at Catterick and she's open to progress upped in trip

runners.name: Veloria
runners.spotlight: Ninth foal; half-sister to winners King Zain (7f including 2yo; RPR 106), Porters Place (7f 2yo; 90), Duvessa (10.6f AW; 87), Kamili (1m; 83), Shringara (1m3f; 79) and Dark Side (US 1m/8.5f); dam 1m-9.4f winner (including Group 3; 108); well-bred newcomer and she needs watching in market.
runners.comment: Well-bred filly who is a half-sister to six winners; needs watching in market on debut

runners.name: Voyager One
runners.spotlight: 15,000gns breeze-up 2yo; half-sister to winners Theotherside (6f including 2yo; RPR 92), Starboy (6f/7f including 2yo; 91), Fat Gladiator (7f AW; 72), Chevillon (1m AW 2yo; 71) and Dandy Fitz (5f; 66); dam 1m winner (including 2yo; 93); has fair target to aim at on debut and market should guide.
runners.comment: Quite a bit to like on paper and market should guide on debut
runners.owner: M L W Bell Racing Ltd

runners.name: Mandolin Rain
runners.spotlight: 75,000euros Irish breeze-up 2yo; weak 20-1 shot on recent Nottingham debut (6f, good to firm; 20-1) and she finished a well-held fourth of seven; this trip should be a better fit on pedigree but she needs a major step forward on her second start.
runners.comment: 75,000euros Irish breeze-up 2yo; well-held fourth over 6f on recent Nottingham debut

runners.name: Highland Girl
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to six winners but she was 50-1 at Goodwood (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago and beat only one rival in that 13-runner maiden; can only be watched after that low-key start.
runners.comment: 50-1 on recent Goodwood debut (7f, good to firm) and she finished out the back

runners.name: Mertoun
runners.spotlight: Made it second-time lucky in handicaps when trouncing his rivals at Windsor and he followed up with a 5l success at Carlisle (1m, good) last month; shot up the weights after those wins but he ran another good race when a close fourth over C&D last month; needs to kick on again to defy this mark but he's still lightly raced and is bred to be useful.
runners.comment: Two easy wins before a close fourth in his hat-trick bid over C&D last week; respected

runners.name: Big Alex Walmsley
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has finished third in Yarmouth handicaps (1m/1m2f, good to firm) in his last two runs but those were five-runner events and he was beaten 5l last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden who was beaten 5l in a small field at Yarmouth latest; others preferred

runners.name: Venetian Lion
runners.spotlight: Gelded after three ordinary efforts in maidens in the spring; raised his game on handicap debut when a close second at Southwell (1m; tongue-tie added) last month and he built on that when landing the odds in good style at Nottingham (8.3f, good to firm); up 7lb but he still looks feasibly treated on that latest form and is open to more progress; major player.
runners.comment: Improver who landed the odds in good style at Nottingham latest; big player again up 7lb

runners.name: Glen Nevis
runners.spotlight: Unexposed gelding who was a fair fourth in a Brighton handicap (1m, good to firm) two weeks ago but he hasn't really progressed so far and needs to find more to make a big impact.
runners.comment: Fair fourth at Brighton (1m) last time but he needs to find more to make a big impact
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Wield
runners.spotlight: All starts at 7f; showed clear promise in novice/maiden events for Andrew Balding in the spring but he's struggled at big prices in two handicaps for current yard; still unexposed but he needs a transformation at this new trip.
runners.comment: Unexposed gelding but he's struggled at big prices in two handicaps for his current yard

runners.name: Legacy Rock
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back handicaps at Windsor (1m, good to firm) in May before a good second in his hat-trick bid at Nottingham; only 1lb higher here but his progress came to a halt at Salisbury (last of six) in June and he has a bit to prove after that.
runners.comment: Won two handicaps at Windsor in May but he was last of six at Salisbury last time

runners.name: Potomac River
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent seven-race maiden but he's on a reduced mark and made some good late headway when fourth of 11 in a Haydock handicap (7f, good) 13 days ago; this step up in trip should suit on pedigree and he's in the mix with Jamie Spencer booked.
runners.comment: 0-7 but he made some promising late headway at Haydock last time; in the mix upped to 1m

runners.name: Calyxoh
runners.spotlight: Overall record of 1-22 but he came from rear to finish third behind a major improver over C&D (good to firm) last week; 2lb lower here and has possibilities if he can find some extra spark.
runners.comment: Record of 1-22 but he's on a dangerous mark and was placed over C&D last week

runners.name: Race To The Stars
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut at Southwell (1m3f, Tapeta) last autumn; flopped at Ascot next time but he bounced back with a close call on handicap debut at Chelmsford (1m2f, AW; 11-4 favourite) in November; 2lb higher on his return but he has plenty of stamina in his pedigree and is open to more progress on this step up to 1m4f; interesting contender.
runners.comment: Went close on handicap debut (1m2f, AW) in November and he needs a close look on return

runners.name: First Officer
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last July and he's finished close up back at this track (1m4f, good to firm) in his last two starts; didn't get much luck when fourth in a Class 3 event last time and he's a player off unchanged mark.
runners.comment: C&D winner who didn't get much luck in a Class 3 here last time; possibilities

runners.name: Be Patient
runners.spotlight: Has form figures of 3112 and that latest second was a close call in a Redcar handicap (1m2f, good to firm) last month; now goes up in trip and grade and but he's only 1lb higher than last time and he should have more to offer; dangerous.
runners.comment: Record of 3112 and that latest second was a close call in Redcar handicap; in the mix

runners.name: Round The Table
runners.spotlight: Easy winner of a Ffos Las maiden (1m2f, good) in June and he made it 2-3 when following up with a front-running win in a Doncaster novice (1m2f, good to firm) last month; now steps up in trip but he pulled 11l clear with the runner-up last time and he's strongly respected off what looks a fair opening mark; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Made it 2-3 when scoring at Doncaster and he's strongly respected on handicap debut

runners.name: Tycoon
runners.spotlight: Almost all of his turf runs have been on good/good to firm; creditable third when upped to 1m4f at Ascot last month and he ran into a handicap blot when a clear second at York two weeks later; hard to rule out another good run but this looks tough against some unexposed rivals.
runners.comment: Chased home major improver at York last time but he could be vulnerable again

runners.name: Astro King
runners.spotlight: Has been smart in his time and is now 10lb lower than when winning the 2023 Cambridgeshire; returned after a long absence in May, but he's been working his way back to form and was only beaten around 2l when fifth at Southwell (1m3f, AW) last time; looks worth another try at this trip and he's in the mix back on turf.
runners.comment: Back from long absence this season but he ran well at Southwell (1m3f) latest; in the mix

runners.name: Cherry Cobbler
runners.spotlight: Has had plenty of racing since winning on the Rowley course (7f, good) under Chloe Lyons in May but he found something new when striding right away over this C&D (good to firm) on Saturday; due an 8lb rise so 3lb well in; much respected.
runners.comment: Two wins for C Lyons, on the Rowley course and emphatic over C&D on Saturday; 3lb well in

runners.name: Cancan In The Rain
runners.spotlight: Two course wins at 1m; two good efforts for new yard this year but a promising-looking run came to nothing when back over 1m at York last time; still worth a look returned to 7f in his first course run since last summer's win; first-time cheekpieces replace regular visor.
runners.comment: Two course wins at 1m; two good runs for new yard this year; ran flat latest

runners.name: Where's Freddy
runners.spotlight: His win in July took C&D record to 3-4 (good to soft and good to firm); had a very awkward start here since and was soon tailed off (stablemate Cherry Cobbler was second) but, given his fine strike-rate here, he can't easily be left out.
runners.comment: C&D record of 3-4 before awkwardly away and tailed off here latest; revival on the cards

runners.name: Sunny Smile
runners.spotlight: Made all for 6f maiden win as 2yo; best form of 2026 when second of six at Sandown (7f) last month but he didn't repeat it there next time on return from wind surgery and has had a few chances off similar marks now.
runners.comment: Sole win over 6f as 2yo; creditable show over 7f at Sandown in July; not so good next time

runners.name: Mr Writer
runners.spotlight: Two narrow wins over 7f (good to firm) either side of apparently failing to stay 1m at Goodwood in June but he found just the one pace when sixth of 11 at Ascot last month and it remains to be seen whether he's still on a winning mark.
runners.comment: Two narrow 7f wins this summer but was vulnerable off this mark at Ascot last month

runners.name: Paladin
runners.spotlight: His first win came over 7f (soft) but better at 1m now, getting up late to win on Wolverhampton AW when making his yard debut in January and finding only a subsequent winner too good at Ascot last month; out of sorts at Redcar since though and reverts to 7f with something to prove.
runners.comment: Has won on soft; best form at 1m but out of sorts over that trip at Redcar latest

runners.name: Piscean Star
runners.spotlight: Successful AW debut as 2yo but was up against it in a sales race next time (sole turf run); back on the AW since, running well in a 7f Chelmsford novice on final 2yo start and doing as well as could be expected on his recent belated reappearance; has a surface query back on turf but should have some potential off this mark.
runners.comment: Won AW debut as 2yo; down the field in sales race on sole turf start; has potential

runners.name: Sun Of Dolly
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced maiden; in good form in 7f Epsom handicaps, persevering well when runner-up latest, and although he has more to do in this higher grade with a stiffer test at the trip he can be on the premises.
runners.comment: Lightly raced maiden; in good form in 7f Epsom handicaps; stiffer stamina test up in grade

runners.name: Here I Bow
runners.spotlight: Soft-ground winner at 7f in France last June; big prices and well held over 7f and 1m for new yard, the latest after wind surgery, but she's dropped just 6lb and looks to have a way to go before she's well handicapped.
runners.comment: Soft-ground 7f winner in France; well held for new yard; probably high in weights still

runners.name: Dashing Dick
runners.spotlight: He's won over 7f but his two July course wins came over 6f; well handicapped now and although his form seems to have slacked off since he went close over this C&D in June this is his first 7f run since; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Two July course wins at 6f; well handicapped; back at 7f for first time since C&D 2nd

runners.name: Jack Langley
runners.spotlight: Positive start for the Charlie Clover yard, readily landing a small-field affair at Lingfield (1m5f, good to firm) in June; better form when runner-up both starts since, latterly over 1m6f here on good to firm; should give another good account.
runners.comment: Positive start for Charlie Clover, including 1m6f course second latest; should go well

runners.name: Sibling Rivelry
runners.spotlight: Came from the rear to score on her reappearance at Windsor (11.5f, good to firm) in May; best effort since when 0.5l second to Society Girl over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; same mark today.
runners.comment: Best effort since reappearance win when second to Society Girl over C&D latest; same mark

runners.name: Traveling Man
runners.spotlight: Best effort when third of six on 1m4f Salisbury handicap debut (good to firm) 26 days ago; a lightly raced profile provides hope that this well-bred sort may build on that.
runners.comment: Best effort when third of six on 1m4f handicap debut; may do better again
runners.owner: P Hickman And Lord Lloyd Webber

runners.name: Society Girl
runners.spotlight: First success when making all to beat the reopposing Sibling Rivelry by 0.5l over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; only 2lb higher and doesn't face much obvious competition for the lead.
runners.comment: Made all to beat Sibling Rivelry over C&D latest and might be able to dictate again

runners.name: Expressionless
runners.spotlight: Not at his best lately (well-held last of three latest) but is 2lb lower than when scoring over this trip on good in the spring so a revival wouldn't surprise with Dylan Cunha among the winners.
runners.comment: Not at best lately but well treated if staging a revival

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qual') (GBB)

runners.name: Inglewood
runners.spotlight: Promising fifth on debut in May was built on when second at Catterick (good to firm) last month; similar form when fairly close third back at Thirsk (again 5f, good) a fortnight ago; has been racing freely so the new hood looks a good move for her AW debut; considered.
runners.comment: Form of her last two starts gives her a big chance and new hood's a good move for AW debut

runners.name: Last Dandelion
runners.spotlight: Best effort when third of ten in a slowly run fillies' maiden over 6f on AW here in June; hasn't matched that on turf subsequently and, while the return here is a positive, she's starting to look exposed; drops back to 5f with cheekpieces discarded after one use.
runners.comment: The return here is a positive but she's looking exposed; back to 5f with headgear off

runners.name: Birkacre Brow
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability when fourth of seven on her Redcar debut (5f, good to firm) in May before running poorly over 6f one month later; plenty of encouragement to be gleaned from her AW debut, however, when runner-up over C&D nine days ago; player.
runners.comment: Encouragement on her AW debut when runner-up over C&D nine days ago; player

runners.name: Glamorous Wild
runners.spotlight: By Twilight Son; fourth foal; half-sister to 5f winner Glamorous Joy (RPR 61); dam 5f winner (including AW; 85), closely related to multiple 5f winner Glamorous Force, out of 5f Group 3 winning half-sister to 5f Group 3 winner Just Glamorous; yard is 0-5 with 2yos this term but that's a speedy pedigree.
runners.comment: By Twilight Son; yard 0-5 with 2yos this term but that's a speedy pedigree; check market

runners.name: Sacred Rhythm
runners.spotlight: 38,000gns yearling; second foal; Mehmas half-sister to 1m winner Harlequin Breeze (RPR 89); dam Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner (95), half-sister to winners Tigerwolf (6f-1m) and Know No Limits (6f/7f 2yo), out of half-sister to Hollywood Derby runner-up Fast And Furious; stable not noted for winning 2yo newcomers but she'll require a market check.
runners.comment: 38,000gns yearling; stable not noted for winning 2yo newcomers; heed any market clues

runners.name: Adelaides Turn
runners.spotlight: By Land Force; fifth foal; half-sister to 5f-7f winner Hannah's Return (including AW; RPR 63); dam 5f/6f winner (mainly AW; 93), half-sister to 5f/6f winner Lordsbridge Boy, out of German 6f 2yo winning sister to German 6.5f 2yo Listed winner Gooseley Lane; widest stall unhelpful but stable was recently off the mark with this year's juveniles, from just a handful of runners.
runners.comment: By Land Force; widest stall unhelpful but yard recently off the mark with this year's 2yos

runners.name: Fancied Angel
runners.spotlight: 8,000gns yearling by Harry Angel; first foal; dam runner-up 5f (RPR 57), closely related to 6f winner Sushi, half-sister to Listed-placed winners Queen Of Time (7f-1m2f) and Bounce (6f 2yo), out of 6f 2yo winner; yard is 1-26 with its juveniles at the start of play yesterday.
runners.comment: 8,000gns yearling by Harry Angel; yard 1-26 with its juveniles at start of play yesterday

runners.name: Leading Raya
runners.spotlight: 250-1 before finishing last in both outings; one for handicaps.
runners.comment: 250-1 before finishing last in both outings; one for handicaps

runners.name: Black Treasure
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros yearling; 50-1 for her debut in the Lily Agnes at Chester (5f, good) in May when she missed the break and couldn't get out of last place; absent since but this is much easier and maybe a new hood will help; market should be a good guide.
runners.comment: 30,000euros yearling; tough May debut and absent since; hood on and market a good guide

races.race_name: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: One Number
runners.spotlight: Promising start over 6f but best form when a one-paced third in 1m Listed race in July; perhaps found yielding ground against him in an easier grade at Galway (7f) next time, finding zero, but he may do better on sand with cheekpieces fitted; leading Irish yard 0-5 with juveniles on AW in Britain.
runners.comment: Promising start over 6f; stays 1m; disappointing when down in class latest

runners.name: Royal Acclamation
runners.spotlight: Third foal; by Zarak; closely related to 1m2f winner Blessed Honour (RPR 86); dam unraced half-sister to Listed winners Doom (7f/1m) and Lilt (1m), out of US 9.5f/1m2f Grade 1 winner; top trainer's juveniles have a cracking strike-rate on sand, 34% in the last five years.
