runners.comment: Dam half-sister to Listed winners at 7f/1m; trainer 34% with 2yos on AW in recent years

runners.name: Berkshire Regal
runners.spotlight: 35,000euros foal; 90,000gns yearling; fifth foal; Calyx half-brother to French winners Illois (9.5f/1m2f AW) and Imbleville (10.5f AW); dam 9.5f-10.7f winner (including AW); likely type; market can guide.
runners.comment: 90,000gns yearling; dam and two siblings were AW winners; market can guide
runners.owner: Berkshire Parts & Panels Ltd No1 Fanclub

runners.name: Minsmere
runners.spotlight: 50,000euros yearling; third foal; Minzaal half-brother to 1m2f winner Heiselectric (RPR 89); dam unraced half-sister to winners Zoffman (1m2f/1m4f Flat and 2m hurdle) and Sheishybrid (12.6f/2m2f Flat and 2m1f/2m2f hurdle); leading trainer is 8-64 with 2yos here in the last five years.
runners.comment: 50,000euros yearling; bred to stay every yard of this trip; market move should be heeded

runners.name: Appassionata
runners.spotlight: Ninth foal; Golden Horn half-sister to six winners including Cabaletta (1m-1m4f including 2yo/Listed);  Pivotal Trigger (7f 2yo/1m2f; 101) and Baihas (1m6f; 90); dam 1m4f-2m winner (including French St Leger; 115); interesting newcomer but no surprise if this is needed.
runners.comment: High-class middle-distance/staying pedigree; interesting but likely to come on for the run

runners.name: Blueabad
runners.spotlight: Second foal; by Blue Point out of 1m 2yo/1m6f winner (RPR 98) who also acted well on Polytrack, half-sister to multiple winner Dubday (including 1m4f Group 3) and Dannyday (useful at 1m5f-2m on AW); yard hasn't had many 2yos run on the AW this year (1-7) but the betting should be helpful.
runners.comment: By Blue Point but more stamina on the dam's side; market should be helpful

runners.name: Dust My Broom
runners.spotlight: 3,000gns yearling; second foal; by Cracksman out of unraced half-sister to winners including Shalaa (6f 2yo Group 1); likely best watched as yard doesn't target 2yo races.
runners.comment: 3,000gns yearling; likely best watched as yard doesn't target these races

runners.name: Yellow Vision
runners.spotlight: 67,000gns yearling; fifth foal; by Space Blues; closely related to Qatari 9.5f winner Sydney Mews; dam 1m/8.4f winner (RPR 93), half-sister to 2m2f Group 2 and smart 2m-2m5f hurdle winner Thomas Hobson; trainer has done well with 2yos on turf this year but less so on AW; likely other days.
runners.comment: 67,000gns yearling; yard has done well with 2yos on turf this year, less so on AW

runners.name: Mount Mogan
runners.spotlight: Gained his fifth course success (all over 7f) when beating six rivals in February off a 3lb lower mark and ran respectably at Epsom (6f, good to firm) on his first start for 155 days last time; steps back up to 1m with claims.
runners.comment: Five-time course winner over 7f; ran respectably at Epsom (6f) following a break last time

runners.name: Dandy Khan
runners.spotlight: All five wins have been at this track, with one coming over C&D, the most recent coming off 1lb higher in February; can miss the break, just as she she did when keeping on into third here over 7f last time, but drops in grade and makes the shortlist.
runners.comment: Five-time course winner (7f/1m); missed the break before finishing third here last time

runners.name: Onslow Gardens
runners.spotlight: 22-race maiden but he has finished in the first three on seven occasions; however, he was down the field at Wolverhampton on his yard debut three weeks ago and needs to bounce back in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: 0-22 and down the field at Wolverhampton on his stable debut; cheekpieces are now added
runners.owner: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya

runners.name: Bajan Bandit
runners.spotlight: Disappointed on his reappearance in June but he's been running well in three starts since the visor was applied, most recently finishing third of 11 in a 0-75 at Haydock (7f, good) 13 days ago; drops in grade with good claims.
runners.comment: Has been running well since the visor went on; third in a 0-75 at Haydock last time

runners.name: Muy Muy Loco
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been here over 1m2f, the most recent coming in February off 3lb higher; below his best over 1m3f at Kempton (refused ro settle) in March when last seen and will need them to go a good gallop now that he's dropping back to 1m.
runners.comment: Both wins have been here over 1m2f; off since March; will want them to a go a good gallop

runners.name: Francisco
runners.spotlight: Two wins from 23 starts include one here over 7f at April; left the impression he's still in form after missing the break here over 7f last week but he's been well beaten in two previous tries over 1m; stamina to prove.
runners.comment: Course winner over 7f; left the impression he's still in form latest; 1m is a concern

runners.name: Manton Road
runners.spotlight: Caught late after hanging left in a C&D classified event two starts ago before gaining his fifth AW success at Wolverhampton (7f, AW; first-time cheekpieces) three weeks ago; a 4lb rise still leaves him fairly treated on old form and he has to be respected.
runners.comment: Had cheekpieces added when winning at Wolverhampton; fairly treated off 4lb higher

runners.name: Whitesnake
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who has finished third in both starts since switching to handicap company, most recently at Wolverhampton over 7f last month; didn't look to be crying out for this step up to 1m but has each-way claims if seeing it out.
runners.comment: Third in both starts in handicaps, including over 7f at Wolverhampton; steps up to 1m

runners.name: Withoutfurtherado
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden but he was runner-up in a 0-80 at York (1m, good to firm) last summer; however, he's struggled in two starts since joining this stable and others look to have stronger claims.
runners.comment: 0-16 and has struggled in two starts since joining this stable; others look stronger

runners.name: Ocean Force
runners.spotlight: Caught the attention of the stewards here on turf over 7f two starts ago and looked unfortunate not to finish closer when sixth of eight here on turf over 6f two months ago; looks a potential improver now stepping up in trip on his handicap debut and market support would look significant.
runners.comment: Has caught the eye here on turf on his last two starts; looks a potential improver

runners.name: Warrnambool
runners.spotlight: Third of nine over this C&D last October when trained by Michael Keady but he beat only one rival home here over 1m2f on his stable debut nine days ago and his record now reads 0-18; drops back in trip with a visor added.
runners.comment: Down the field here over 1m2f on his stable debut; now 0-18; back to 1m with the visor on

runners.name: Nubough
runners.spotlight: Five wins include two here over 6f; runner-up here over 7f in January but he hasn't matched that level in three starts since and failed to beat a rival home on his only previous try over 1m; returns from three months off.
runners.comment: Five-time winner (6f/7f); failed to beat a rival home on his only previous try over 1m

runners.name: Starlight Sami
runners.spotlight: Placed on four occasions prior to his 7f win at Salisbury in May off 2lb lower; disappointing on both starts since but with possible excuses (early scrimmaging/1m) and he has proved himself over C&D; needs a second look.
runners.comment: Disappointing last two starts but with possible excuses and he has proved himself over C&D

runners.name: Yachtsman
runners.spotlight: Close fourth over C&D in March and off the mark at Windsor (6f, good) in May; off 57 days before failing to figure at Wolverhampton (16-1) five weeks ago, but he's not ruled out.
runners.comment: Close over C&D in March and off the mark at Windsor (6f) in May; off 57 days before latest

runners.name: Red Hat Eagle
runners.spotlight: Winner here but that was in 2023 and there's been no win anywhere since July 2024; not far away this summer and he continues down the weights but latest performance (C&D) won't cut the mustard; first-time tongue-tie joins the recent cheekpieces.
runners.comment: No win since July 2024; first-time tongue-tie joins the recent cheekpieces

runners.name: Powder Monkey
runners.spotlight: One of the youngsters in this field and he's had just four races, below-form sixth of 14 last time on handicap debut at Windsor (6f; 15-2); earlier efforts, including on Tapeta, means he can't be dismissed.
runners.comment: One of the youngsters and he can't be dismissed despite his below-form handicap debut

runners.name: Paranjape
runners.spotlight: Suited by AW and won at Wolverhampton (6f maiden) in November, with two bits of form on Chelmsford Polytrack too; beaten a neck at Southwell (6f) in April but below form since over 6f, 7f and 1m, so others look more solid; wears headgear first time.
runners.comment: Below form last three starts (6f, 7f and 1m); others look more solid; wears first headgear
runners.owner: G H Thompson & S P C Woods

runners.name: Gunfighter
runners.spotlight: Turned things around with a win at Southwell (7f, Tapeta) last month but he was only seventh of ten in his follow-up bid at Wolverhampton (favourite); used to act on Polytrack; in-form yard also runs Split Elevens; inconsistent.
runners.comment: Won at Southwell last month but only seventh in his follow-up bid; inconsistent

runners.name: Sant Alessio
runners.spotlight: Had early form on Polytrack; two wins from the front last year and he's back to last November's winning mark following three modest shows this term; unraced over shorter than 1m since July 2024 and perhaps it will help but he is drawn wide.
runners.comment: Modest this term; unraced over shorter than 1m since July 2024 and perhaps it will help

runners.name: State Of Madness
runners.spotlight: 1-18 on other AW tracks (unraced here) but there's plenty on turf and AW to suggest that he has each-way claims.
runners.comment: 1-18 on other AW tracks (unraced here) but plenty suggests that he has each-way claims
runners.owner: The Likely Lads & S & A Mares

runners.name: Double Time
runners.spotlight: Front-runner whose most recent win was at Kempton (1m, AW) last October off 1lb lower; not so good in his only four races since; absent 187 days before his last of 12 at Sandown four weeks ago, so he's a touch speculative this time.
runners.comment: Front-runner; absent 187 days before his last of 12 at Sandown four weeks ago

runners.name: The Bitter Moose
runners.spotlight: C&D scorer in 2023 who also won at Epsom (made all; 3lb higher today) last August; 2026 performances don't look good enough, third of five on last two outings.
runners.comment: 2026 performances don't look good enough, third of five on last two outings

runners.name: Bold Suitor
runners.spotlight: Eight AW wins and latest was over C&D (April); backward steps in his two starts since, finishing last of seven on latest (C&D; 33-1) after two months off but he now drops back in class.
runners.comment: Latest win was over C&D (April); backward steps in his two starts since

runners.name: Dontspoilasale
runners.spotlight: No significant impact in his three runs for this yard, although he wasn't beaten far on second occasion; attractively weighted on lots of Irish AW form, so needs a close look; market reference recommended.
runners.comment: No significant impact in his three runs for this yard; well in on lots of Irish AW form

runners.name: Dancing Rinca
runners.spotlight: Sole dirt run was on debut; 7yo who often ran well on turf in the USA, albeit winning just once (6.5f, firm) back in 2023; showed some ability on both runs last month but others bring more solid claims; usually blinkered in USA and now tries cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Nearly all career in USA; two runs for yard; usually blinkered in USA, now cheekpieces

runners.name: Apex Star
runners.spotlight: 0-9 but he has run several good races in defeat this summer, most recently finishing third of eight at Leicester (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; each-way shout once again.
runners.comment: Several solid runs this summer but still seeking a first win; each-way shout

runners.name: Royal County Glory
runners.spotlight: The winner of one of his 11 starts in Ireland, namely a 7f handicap at Dundalk in April; makes his stable debut at a realistic level and the betting should be informative after an 80-day break.
runners.comment: 1-11 in Ireland; best form on AW; market instructive on this stable debut

runners.name: Fuseboard
runners.spotlight: He has offered more following wind and gelding operations, fourth over 7f here in May before a commanding front-running win at Wolverhampton (5f) last month; an 8lb rise unlikely to prove beyond him and he's a key player despite his wide stall.
runners.comment: Easy win at Wolverhampton (5f) last month; drawn wide but retains potential

runners.name: Lieutenant Sir
runners.spotlight: Beat five rivals at Ffos Las (6f, good) in June but he has followed that with two heavy defeats; new blinkers need to turn things around.
runners.comment: Ffos Las win in June has been followed by two heavy defeats; now tried in blinkers

runners.name: Mister Moet
runners.spotlight: Two course wins earlier in the year; running okay with quite being at his best this summer; on a competitive mark and he can't be discounted.
runners.comment: Two course wins this year; running okay with quite being at his best this summer

runners.name: Reality Queen
runners.spotlight: The winner of two of her 11 starts, both over 5.7f at Bath on fast ground; only fourth back at Bath last time and she will need a career best to defy top weight; unplaced all four AW starts.
runners.comment: Two Bath wins to her name; unplaced all four AW starts; career best required

runners.name: Dark Mandate
runners.spotlight: Ran his best race for Charles Hills when third of 12 in a 6f Kempton nursery 302 days ago; gelded during his absence and returns off a 2lb lower mark and with a hood fitted; interesting on stable debut (same owner).
runners.comment: Best run for C Hills when 3rd at Kempton 302 days ago; hooded for stable/seasonal debut

runners.name: Pennine Way
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden but she has been placed in 7f handicaps on her last two starts; has the pace to be effective back at 6f; still has time to deliver an improved showing.
runners.comment: Placed in 7f handicaps on last two starts; quick enough for 6f; still time to do better

runners.name: Solar Phoenix
runners.spotlight: His two handicap runs have been unconvincing, including when tried in blinkers at Brighton (7f, good to firm) two weeks ago; drop to 6f not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Down the field in two handicap runs over further; drop to 6f not enough to tempt

runners.name: King Cherry
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in all five starts, including 7f handicaps on last two runs; edging down the weights and dropping in trip could help; not especially solid though.
runners.comment: Unplaced all five starts; dropping down the weights but not solid now returning to 6f

runners.name: Mayfair Market
runners.spotlight: Some promise as a 2yo; struggled this year and although she is easing down the weights, the new blinkers and drop in trip need to have a transformative effect.
runners.comment: Struggled in handicaps over further this year; blinkers tried now back at 6f

runners.name: Love Alive
runners.spotlight: 5f AW win for Martin Dunne in February and now rated 9lb lower; not run too badly in either start for John Butler without suggesting she was the answer this time.
runners.comment: 9lb lower than for a 5f win in February; not run too badly in either start for new yard

races.race_name: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: So Lovely
runners.spotlight: By Wootton Bassett out of Moyglare winner and dual Classic winner Love; made a promising introduction over 1m at this venue, keeping for second behind the favourite; just denied by her main market rival over 7f at Goodwood three weeks ago; will probably need further than this in time, but can make amends.
runners.comment: Promising debut over 1m at this venue, just denied over 7f at Goodwood, can make amends
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Miss Hong Kong
runners.spotlight: E165,000 Y; fourth foal; Churchill filly is sister to winners Naval Force and Walt Whitman, half-sister to US turf winner Ma France; dam 7f 2yo winner;
runners.comment: E165,000 yearling, Churchill filly is sister to two winners, half-sister to another

runners.name: Brooq
runners.spotlight: E280,000 Y; first foal; by Wootton Bassett, dam French 1m 2yo winner, half-sister to German 1m4f Group 1 winner Sibayan, out of French 1m4f/1m6f Listed winner from family of Derby/Arc winner Sinndar.
runners.comment: E280,000 yearling, first foal, by Wootton Bassett, winning dam from strong Aga Khan family

runners.name: Ever My Treasure
runners.spotlight: E50,000 Breeze Up purchase; ninth foal; half-sister by Blackbeard to six winners, notably Group 3 scorer Term Of Endearment; dam 7f 2yo/1m2f Listed winner by Montjeu; hooded for debut.
runners.comment: Half-sister by Blackbeard to six winners, notably Group 3 scorer Term Of Endearment, hood

runners.name: Isle Of Capri
runners.spotlight: Slow starter when sixth in a strong maiden at the Curragh; stable well represented here, with riding plans pointing to the Group 1-entered Miss Hong Kong as the number one.
runners.comment: Slow starter when sixth in a strong maiden at the Curragh, stable well represented here
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Little Darling
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; closely related to a winner in Italy; dam a Listed winner; decent pedigree.
runners.comment: Fourth foal; closely related to a winner in Italy, dam a Listed winner, decent pedigree
runners.owner: Barnane Stud & Hollywood Stud Ireland Limited

runners.name: Native Jewel
runners.spotlight: E400,000 yearling; tenth foal; half-sister by Wootton Bassett to Group 1 Garswood (Prix Maurice de Gheest), Zagitova (Group-placed) and Frill; unraced dam closely related to 7f Group 3 winner Infallible (dam of 1m Group 1 winner Veracious)
runners.comment: E400,000 yearling, Wootton Bassett half-sister to Prix Maurice de Gheest winner Garswood

runners.name: Long Haired Lady
runners.spotlight: E72,000 Y; second foal; by Camelot; dam 7f AW winner (RPR 76), half-sister to winners Wigmore Hall (Canadian 1m4f Grade 1), Ocean Road (US 1m1f Grade 1) and Lady Liberty (German 1m2f Listed); noteworthy.
runners.comment: Camelot filly whose dam is a half-sister to two North American Grade 1 winners, noteworthy

runners.name: Zenith Blaze
runners.spotlight: Second foal; half-sister by Kingman to 1m4f AW winner Bay Of Stars; dam was a course Listed winner over 1m4f; plenty of stamina on the dam's side.
runners.comment: Half-sister by Kingman to a 1m4f AW winner, dam was a course Listed winner over 1m4f

runners.name: Bougie Gals
runners.spotlight: 95,000gns yearling, E210,000 Breeze Up; eighth foal; No Nay Never, half-sister to winners including 6f Group 2 winner Gustavus Weston and Listed-placed sprint winner Kape Moss; dam 1m AW winner
runners.comment: E210,000 Breeze Up buy, half-sister by No Nay Never to 6f Group 2 winner Gustavus Weston

runners.name: Fair Say
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; Kingman filly is a sister to three winners, half-sister to three winners, including Listed scorer Georgeville (8.4f-1m2f inc Listed; 112) and Pacific Mission (Grade 1 placed), dam a Group 3 winner by Dansili.
runners.comment: Kingman filly is a sister to three winners/half-sister to three winners, interesting

runners.name: Voice Of You
runners.spotlight: Has shown definite signs of winning potential in maidens here and at the Curragh; this will qualify her for handicaps.
runners.comment: Has shown definite signs of winning potential in maidens here and at the Curragh

runners.name: Villaray
runners.spotlight: Might prefer further than this; was staying on late over C&D on debut four weeks ago, beaten 7l in eight (of 12); runner-up won easily at Gowran last week.
runners.comment: Might prefer further than this, was staying on late over C&D on debut four weeks ago

runners.name: Voyage Of Survival
runners.spotlight: Towards the back in races at Naas and Chepstow, cheekpieces fitted, faces tough task.
runners.comment: Towards the back in races at Naas and Chepstow, cheekpieces fitted, faces tough task

runners.name: Katty
runners.spotlight: 50-1 when running respectably over 6f at the Curragh on recent debut; open to improvement.
runners.comment: 50-1 when running respectably over 6f at the Curragh on recent debut, open to improvement

races.race_name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Banks Of The Boyne
runners.spotlight: Showed little on his first two starts; was able to dictate in a 6f Fairyhouse maiden and gave a much-improved display to take second; has picked up valuable experience in nurseries, second to a well-handicapped runner at the Curragh, fair fourth at Galway; the most appealing of those that have run.
runners.comment: Has picked up valuable experience in nurseries, most appealing of those that have run

runners.name: Lucy's Promise
runners.spotlight: Did not show much on first two starts; took a step in the right direction when a staying-on sixth of 17 at Navan, in front of The Green Helmet (seventh); however, confidence is dented by her eclipse in a Curragh nursery, never looked like featuring, last of eight.
runners.comment: In front of The Green Helmet when sixth at Navan, doubts raised by a poor nursery run

runners.name: The Green Helmet
runners.spotlight: Stepped up from a satisfactory debut in a 17-runner Navan event when third at Sligo; would have been closer but for becoming unbalanced at a track crossing point around two furlongs down; should not be far away.
runners.comment: Stepped up from a satisfactory Navan debut when third at Sligo, should not be far away

runners.name: Romance
runners.spotlight: Sent off at 66-1 on debut at Roscommon, shaped with promise, staying on in the closing stages for a 6l fifth behind subsequent Listed winner Dancing Destiny; failed to match that form at Galway, when finished behind Sovreigns Joy.
runners.comment: Promising first effort at Roscommon, finished behind Sovreigns Joy at Galway

runners.name: Essence Of Time
runners.spotlight: 1,000gns yearling; fourth foal; Palace Pier filly, dam French Group-placed 1m winner is a sister to winners.
runners.comment: Palace Pier filly, dam French Group-placed 1m winner is a sister to winners cheap buy

runners.name: Togetherwearefree
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-sister by State Of Rest to Pass The Buck who has won a claiming race for the stable this season; dam placed, half-sister to 1m Listed winner Horoscope.
runners.comment: Half-sister by State Of Rest to Pass The Buck who has won a claiming race for the stable

runners.name: Dear Theodosia
runners.spotlight: Has failed to beat a single opponent in races here and at Galway; can be ruled out.
runners.comment: Has failed to beat a single opponent in races here and at Galway, can be ruled out

runners.name: Kilconnell
runners.spotlight: 6,500gns yearling; second foal; Too Darn Hot colt, unraced dam closely related to a 5f winner, half-sister to Richmond Stakes winner Prolific and Deal Breaker (US 1m stakes).
runners.comment: Too Darn Hot colt, dam an unraced half-sister to a Richmond Stakes winner, cheap yearling

runners.name: Melchizedek
runners.spotlight: E25,000 foal purchase, retained at E20,000 as a yearling; sixth foal; half-brother by Awtaad to two winners; dam unraced half-sister to Listed winners Kingsgate Prince and Captain Ramius.
runners.comment: Half-brother by Awtaad to two winners, dam an unraced half-sister to Listed winners

runners.name: Spanish View
runners.spotlight: Failed to make much impression in a decent maiden at Down Royal; several winners have emerged from that race; may do better now.
runners.comment: Failed to make much impression in a decent maiden at Down Royal, may do better now

runners.name: Sovreigns Joy
runners.spotlight: Hampered at the start at Galway, made some late progress; has potential for improvement and enjoys a slight edge over Romance.
runners.comment: Hampered at the start at Galway, made some late progress, potential for improvement
runners.owner: Gary Devlin & C G Bryson & Kevin Osborne

runners.name: Blitogue
runners.spotlight: Not disgraced when fifth in a nine-runner contest at Fairyhouse in June; will benefit from getting more experience now.
runners.comment: Not disgraced at Fairyhouse in June, will benefit from getting more experience now
runners.owner: Mrs F Cumiskey & W R Crawford

runners.name: Summer Sent You
runners.spotlight: Big price first time out at Gowran; slowly away and unable to make any impact.
runners.comment: Big price first time out at Gowran, slowly away and unable to make any impact

runners.name: Letmeentertainyou
runners.spotlight: Never in the hunt over 5f at Cork on debut; pedigree suggests 7f will suit better.
runners.comment: Never in the hunt over 5f at Cork on debut, pedigree suggests 7f will suit better

runners.name: Battle Ready
runners.spotlight: Slowly away and never involved first time out at Gowran; unlikely to feature.
runners.comment: Slowly away and never involved first time out at Gowran, unlikely to feature

runners.name: Buck Jones
runners.spotlight: Mid-field run at Roscommon gives him something to build on; plenty of improvement needed.
runners.comment: Mid-field run at Roscommon gives him something to build on, plenty of improvement needed

runners.name: Bear Right
runners.spotlight: Has made the frame in her last five starts in handicaps from 7f to 1m on varying ground; beaten favourite when third over C&D last month, doing well after losing her position early; neck second to Zheleznaya Dama at Naas on latest; does not need to improve much.
runners.comment: Does not need to improve much to win a race, neck second to Zheleznaya Dama on latest

runners.name: Zheleznaya Dama
runners.spotlight: Good third in a nursery in September; saddle slipped at Cork; back on track with fifth at Limerick; gave way late on when second at Killarney; held on for a front-running win from Bear Right at Naas; not certain to uphold the form.
runners.comment: Held on for a front-running win from Bear Right at Naas, not certain to uphold the form

runners.name: La La Lucrative
runners.spotlight: Winner of two of his four starts this season, rising an aggregate 20lb from a basement mark; gave another bright display when fourth behind today's rival Faoladh at Galway.
runners.comment: Winner of two of his four starts this season, another bright display when fourth at Galway

runners.name: Kc Bear
runners.spotlight: Had an off day at Dundalk last time; otherwise never out of the first four in handicaps; sole win was gained over 6f on AW but has stayed effectively over further than this on turf.
runners.comment: Had an off day at Dundalk last time, otherwise never out of the first four in handicaps

runners.name: Altimara
runners.spotlight: Landed back-to-back handicaps over C&D last year, including this race; placed twice over 1m subsequently; below best on first two runs this year; step in right direction with staying-on sixth at Fairyhouse; big chance after fifth in Naas race won by Zheleznaya Dama.
runners.comment: Won this race last year, big chance after fifth in Naas race won by Zheleznaya Dama

runners.name: All Hail
runners.spotlight: Showed promise at two, notably when second in a 6f maiden at Navan; one decent run over 5f at the same venue this season, overall form is unconvincing.
runners.comment: Showed promise at two, one decent run over 5f this season, overall form is unconvincing

runners.name: Faoladh
runners.spotlight: Gained second career win at Down Royal in May (7f, good); lost form before regaining it to record a long-priced win on the second of two Galway festival starts; possibly vulnerable.
runners.comment: Long-priced winner on the second of two Galway festival starts, possibly vulnerable

runners.name: Shamanka
runners.spotlight: Maiden raced mostly on AW for Natalia Lupini, fair form at up to 1m, placed three times; best of three runs for this stable when fourth over 5f at Down Royal.
runners.comment: Placed three times, best of three runs for this stable when fourth over 5f at Down Royal

runners.name: Sporting Hero
runners.spotlight: Fine strike-rate of 9-28 on the AW; gained first win on turf at Navan in April off 6lb lower (5f, gd-yld), making all; soundly beaten off revised mark twice since; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, much better known on AW (nine wins), two below-par runs since sole turf win

runners.name: Jazzit
runners.spotlight: Placed three times at sprint distances on AW earlier in the year; now appears to be on the brink of a breakthrough; third in a 19-runner 6f event at Cork, second in a 17-runner contest over C&D on latest; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, maiden who appears to be on the brink of a breakthrough, C&D second latest

runners.name: Naoi
runners.spotlight: Placed in three maidens, soundly beaten on only handicap start; seasonal/stable debut and best watched in the circumstances.
runners.comment: Placed in three maidens, soundly beaten on only handicap start, seasonal/stable debut

runners.name: Ballymagreehan
runners.spotlight: Not in the first six in three outings since incurring a sharp rise for a Gowran win in May; others preferred.
runners.comment: Not in the first six in three outings since incurring a sharp rise for a Gowran win in May

runners.name: Brains
runners.spotlight: Veteran winner of 14 races (11 on AW); respectable form in recent months, highlighted by a Roscommon second; another solid display when fifth of 17 here a fortnight ago, on the heels of runner-up Jazzit (second reserve) with Gordon Bennett among those behind.
runners.comment: Veteran winner of 14 races, decent form lately, not beaten far over C&D two weeks ago

runners.name: Gordon Bennett
runners.spotlight: Best form in 2022, winning three times in a July-to-September spell, and rising to a career-high mark of 94; frustrating in recent seasons; joined Peter Fahey late last year after a claiming-race third on AW; stumbled out of the stalls here two weeks ago on reappearance, left with too much to do; capable of better.
runners.comment: Stumbled out of the stalls here two weeks ago, left with too much to do, capable of better

runners.name: Ninth Crusade
runners.spotlight: Breeze-up purchase cost £205,000; justified favouritism on debut at Wolverhampton (6f); failed to build on that in two subsequent outings in Britain; runner-up on the second of two Dundalk nursery outings; may improve from his turf/seasonal debut at Naas last month; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, AW winner, may improve from his turf/seasonal debut at Naas last month

runners.name: Mr Perth
runners.spotlight: Weak form in early-season maidens; well supported on handicap debut at Galway, was left with plenty to do after suffering interference out of the stalls; stayed on to some effect; less exposed than many of these; has a live chance.
runners.comment: Weak form in early-season maidens, well supported on handicap debut at Galway, may improve

runners.name: Hazrama
runners.spotlight: Never closer than tenth in three outings; most recent run was in a claimer; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Never closer than tenth in three outings, most recent run was in a claimer, hard to fancy
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Oppenheimer
runners.spotlight: Has improved since being gelded; ran on well to finish seventh of 20 over 6f at the Curragh in early May (good); after a break, well-supported favourite when fourth at Gowran recently; was squeezed for room in the closing stages, can do better.
runners.comment: Well-supported favourite when fourth at Gowran, squeezed for room in the closing stages

runners.name: Phoenix Pairc
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 11 starts came on AW in maiden over 7f last October; well held in handicaps; towards the rear in Naas event dominated by Zheleznaya Dama and Bear Right.
runners.comment: Towards the rear in Naas event dominated by Zheleznaya Dama and Bear Right, up against it

runners.name: Rappell
runners.spotlight: In good fettle before a disappointing effort in a Naas event won by Zheleznaya Dama; form of his Limerick win was boosted by the runner-up when winning at Cork.
runners.comment: In good form before a disappointing effort in a Naas event won by Zheleznaya Dama

runners.name: Free Solo
runners.spotlight: Gained the sixth win of his career at Roscommon this time last year; 7lb lower now, but this season's form offers limited hope.
runners.comment: Won off 7lb higher at Roscommon 12 months ago, this season's form offers limited hope

races.race_name: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Vinnie Roe Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Cannes
runners.spotlight: Twice runner-up before winning a C&D maiden in May; well beaten when favourite on handicap debut in the King George V Stakes at Royal Ascot (won by a stablemate); looked short of pace when third of eight in a 1m4f handicap at Goodwood; extra two furlongs should help.
runners.comment: Course 1m4f maiden winner, needs to step up on the form of two handicap runs in Britain
runners.owner: Al Shaqab Racing & Stall Perlen AB

runners.name: Keepsgettingbetter
runners.spotlight: Won Dundalk handicaps over 1m and extended 1m2f in the spring; has remained dependable on turf; however, she was no match for Wyman here last month and faces a tough task on these terms.
runners.comment: Useful handicapper, no match for Wyman here last month, faces tough task on these terms
runners.owner: Mrs Richard Henry & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Piazza San Marco
runners.spotlight: Holds a big chance in theory, though possibly flattered by a juvenile rating of 105 acquired after a four-race campaign, highlighted by a Galway maiden win; beaten favourite when fourth of eight in a high-class edition of the 1m1f Eyrefield Stakes won by Christmas Day; ended with a low-key display in a Group 1 at Saint-Cloud; unknown quantity as a stayer.
runners.comment: Big chance in theory, possibly flattered by juvenile rating, unknown quantity as a stayer
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Wyman
runners.spotlight: Some promise in two runs as a juvenile; improved from his seasonal debut here to win a Curragh maiden, both over 1m2f; did well on the latter occasion as he had to wait for room; backed that up with victory in a four-runner event over 1m5f here four weeks ago; speedy pedigree on the dam's side, stamina derived from his sire.
runners.comment: Steps up in class after 1m5f course win, has plenty of stamina derived from his sire

runners.name: Teologia
runners.spotlight: Promoted a total of 24lb in the ratings for a Down Royal hat-trick; steps into a different league, needs to find considerably more to pose a serious threat.
runners.comment: Promoted a total of 24lb in the ratings for a Down Royal hat-trick, takes a jump in class

runners.name: Abbotsford
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced son of Frankel; gelded after finishing second to an odds-on shot in 1m2f Cork maiden in May, having run green; one-time Irish Derby entry left an impression he would stay this far with a smooth 1m4f win at Galway; progressive sort is out of a half-sister to St Leger winner Brian Boru.
runners.comment: Left an impression he would stay this far with a smooth 1m4f win at Galway, progressive

runners.name: Madbadanddangerous
runners.spotlight: Consistent apart from a poor Navan run in May; bounced back from that reverse to win the Ulster Derby over 1m5f at Down Royal in June; maintained progress with a Galway festival win, defying a big burden in a lower handicap grade; stays well.
runners.comment: Won the valuable Ulster Derby Handicap, continued progress with Galway win in lower grade

runners.name: Trojan Fighter
runners.spotlight: Unraced at two; showed plenty of improvement to land a 1m5f Ballinrobe maiden on his third start; met trouble in running in Navan race won by the smart Limestone; may struggle to reverse Down Royal handicap form with Madbadanddangerous.
runners.comment: Maiden winner over 1m5f, may struggle to reverse handicap form with Madbadanddangerous

runners.name: Highwayman
runners.spotlight: Modest form at up to 1m before a runaway success when stepped up in trip at Killarney; promoted a punitive 17lb for that success over just short of 1m4f; faces a tough task at this level.
runners.comment: Modest form before a runaway success when stepped up in trip at Killarney, tough task here

races.race_name: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap

runners.name: Gaelic Drills
runners.spotlight: Quite lightly-raced 3yo has a bit to find with Darius Dark on Curragh run, plenty keen and not clear run at Limerick on latest; may yet do better if settling.
runners.comment: Too keen in both handicap runs; may yet do better if settling

runners.name: Sea Coral
runners.spotlight: Hasn't added to Bellewstown maiden win of last summer although creditable handicap placings last month at Tramore and Ballinrobe; reportedly saddle slipped leaving stalls at Gowran on latest so that run forgiven; others look better handicapped.
runners.comment: Excuses last time, nonetheless others look better handicapped

runners.name: Celtic Druid
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back Dundalk wins in the spring, and close second at Dundalk last month; previously put up his best turf effort of the season when close third to Darius Dark over 1m4f at the Curragh; steps up in grade.
runners.comment: Solid turf and AW form of late; place claims

runners.name: Party Dress
runners.spotlight: Hurdle winner has won twice on the Flat, the latest over 2m1f at Limerick in 2025; hasn't been too far away of late and has been dropped a few lbs, now 3lb below that winning mark.
runners.comment: Hasn't been too far away of late and now 3lb below last winning mark

runners.name: Satono Chevalier
runners.spotlight: Much improved this year, recording wins at Navan, Ballinrobe and over just shy of this trip at Limerick in June; held off career-high marks last twice, trip possibly too far at Killarney and in Galway premier handicap; drops back in grade so respected, but this ground may be on the quick side.
runners.comment: Drops back in grade so respected but this ground may be on the quick side

runners.name: Darius Dark
runners.spotlight: Much improved when upped to 1m4f, rattling off a hat-trick of wins, at Cork, here and the Curragh; didn't do himself justice at Galway when keen but remains of interest.
runners.comment: Middle leg of 1m4f treble came here; too keen at Galway latest but remains of interest

runners.name: Lauderdale King
runners.spotlight: Good opening efforts in handicaps, staying on late over 1m2f at Cork and raced handier over slightly shorter at Gowran, weakening late on when only beaten 1l into fourth; upped in trip now and contender if he stays.
runners.comment: Good opening efforts in handicaps; upped in trip and contender if he stays

runners.name: Ehteyat
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner whose turf win came over 1m6f on heavy at Listowel last year; back from hurdling campaign last season and stablemate of top-weight may just need this.
runners.comment: Back from hurdling campaign last season and stablemate of top-weight may just need this

runners.name: Cooley's Mist
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over C&D last month on good ground, soft ground probably against him at Galway (beaten when hampered); cheekpieces retained and could bounce back.
runners.comment: C&D win off 5lb lower last month; soft ground against him at Galway so could bounce back

runners.name: Pavilion End
runners.spotlight: Just 1m4f AW maiden win to his name but arrives on the back of two fine runs on turf, had the run of the race when pipped over 1m6f at Fairyhouse (rated race) and again made plenty of use of when third in 1m3f Naas handicap early this month; definite claims back up in trip.
runners.comment: Prominent racer with two good recent efforts in defeat; definite player

runners.name: Harry's Legacy
runners.spotlight: Two flat wins in 2022 included here over 1m7f; long losing stretch since and not too much to take from recent efforts; cheekpieces now added.
runners.comment: On a long losing stretch since and not too much to take from recent efforts

runners.name: Ben Hur
runners.spotlight: Useful juvenile hurdler last season reappeared from six months' absence when well-backed favourite on flat handicap debut at Galway festival, not quite getting home over 2m1f, having led home turn, finishing a good third of 19; 3lb higher but likely major player back slightly in trip.
runners.comment: Stamina failed at Galway when backed; big player dropped in trip here

runners.name: Port Arthur
runners.spotlight: All three runs have been over 6f, showing definite promise last autumn at Naas and the Curragh, reappearing early this month at former venue when never dangerous staying-on third of 5 (couple of 80+ rated rivals behind) in conditions event; half-brother Texas Rock won over 1m so good chance he'll stay, big player if he does.
runners.comment: Naas comeback third encouraging; definite player if he stays
runners.owner: Joseph E Keeling & Aidan Gleeson & M C Grassick

runners.name: Goddess Of War
runners.spotlight: South African-bred filly was set a stiff task on debut in Gowran winners' contest last month, showing promise when a staying-on fourth over 9.5f; technically not yet a 3yo (born in October 2023) so can be expected to improve with time; not sure this drop in trip will suit.
runners.comment: South African-bred shaped well on debut last month; bred to improve with time

runners.name: Uncle Goalie
runners.spotlight: Respectable debut run at Gowran in May over this trip, returning from a couple of months' break with decent third at Galway over 7f; more possible back at 1m.
runners.comment: Has shown ability in both maidens, return to 1m likely to suit

runners.name: Holy Lettuce
runners.spotlight: Hint of promise on debut at Killarney last month and nice bit of improvement 9 days later when staying on late to chase home a long odds-on shot at Cork (clear of remainder); over 1m; more possibly needed but definite contender.
runners.comment: Clear Cork second makes him a definite player

runners.name: My Shayla
runners.spotlight: Phoenix Of Spain filly cost E13,000 as a yearling, related to three prolific and useful winners, two of them on AW; tongue-tied, never competitive but not discredited on Dundalk debut last month; may need more experience
runners.comment: Never competitive but not discredited on Dundalk debut last month; may need more time

runners.name: King Of Eze
runners.spotlight: Boiled over, bolted to post and unseated rider before Curragh debut, where he ran keen and dropped out to finish in rear; hood didn't appear have a major impact at Dundalk last month, can only be watched for now.
runners.comment: Couple of underwhelming runs, best watched for now

runners.name: Scorcher's Son
runners.spotlight: Too Darn Hot gelding was a 450,000gns yearling; brother to 7f/7.4f 2yo winner Zenjabeela (inc AW; RPR 91), half-brother to three winners inc Cell Sa Beela (7f/7.4f inc 2yo/Listed; 102); dam unraced half-sister to 1m Group 1 winners Alpha Centauri and Alpine Star; well-bred 4yo making a belated debut, has to be respected.
runners.comment: 450,000gns yearling; belated debut, has to be respected

runners.name: Mothel Abbey
runners.spotlight: Arizona gelding; dam 1m2f-1m4f winner (inc AW; RPR 72), half-sister to 1m-10.6f winner Sleepy Head; minor late headway after slow start on debut here a fortnight ago; improvement likely but may need more time.
runners.comment: Minor late headway after slow start on debut here a fortnight ago; may need more time
runners.owner: John Maurice Murphy & Michael O Phelan

runners.name: Nottooshabby
runners.spotlight: Midfield finish here a fortnight ago was a bit more encouraging but likely more one for handicaps in due course.
runners.comment: Midfield finish a fortnight ago a bit more encouraging but likely more one for handicaps

runners.name: Aghadrum Boy
runners.spotlight: Both recent runs suggest he'll be of more interest when going handicapping.
runners.comment: Both recent runs suggest he'll be of more interest when going handicapping

runners.name: Aiteall
runners.spotlight: Well-bred Wootton Bassett gelding had run in a barrier trial before two ordinary recent runs in maidens, latest when never landing a blow over 1m4f at Tramore five days ago; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Two ordinary recent runs in maidens; best watched for now

runners.name: Eldorado Glory
runners.spotlight: Cotai Glory half-brother to 1m5f turf/2m AW winner Elle Dorado Rock (RPR 69); dam 1m 2yo winner (71), half-sister to Group-placed 9.4f-11.4f winner Majeed; never better than midfield on AW debut five days ago, seems best watched.
runners.comment: Never better than midfield on AW debut five days ago, seems best watched

runners.name: Lonelyharbourwall
runners.spotlight: Towards the rear throughout on debut in a Roscommon bumper earlier this month and 8 days later didn't count in midfield in Gowran flat maiden (9.5f); hard to see him making the required improvement to feature here.
runners.comment: Two recent runs don't suggest he'll have an impact here

runners.name: Time Whisperer
runners.spotlight: Late gains into midfield on debut at Gowran (1m) in May, catching the attention of the stewards (rider reported he ran green before staying on); improvement likely although lacks a recent run.
runners.comment: Caught stewards attention on Gowran debut; improvement likely but lacks a recent run

runners.name: Pink Oxalis
runners.spotlight: Four wins last year, culminating in C&D premier handicap success off 85; pick of this season's form when chasing home a progressive all-the-way 3yo winner at the Curragh (good-to-firm); okay Galway effort on latest under top-weight, so has to enter calculations.
runners.comment: C&D premier handicap winner last term; 5lb higher but top-weight respected

runners.name: Tachos
runners.spotlight: Last of two wins came here over 1m1f last summer off 74; seasonal-best came over same C&D a fortnight ago when strong-finishing third (from a wide draw) of 22 to Bella Colombia (fourth has won since); nice turn around in weights with that rival here and cheekpieces added; should go well.
runners.comment: Recent strong-finishing third to Bella Colombia here augurs well at the revised weights

runners.name: Mallavelly
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last summer is without a win this year but two good runs in Curragh contests on quick ground; not at same level at Gowran on latest, having raced prominently; cheekpieces now added.
runners.comment: Below best latest but previous Curragh runs put her in the mix; cheekpieces added

runners.name: Bella Colombia
runners.spotlight: Improving mare seeking to complete a hat-trick, following a Killarney success when overcoming 7lb rise in 1m1f contest here a fortnight ago, having to wait for an opening and getting first run on runner-up when holding on by a head (pair clear); another 8lb rise to overcome but thriving.
runners.comment: Hat-trick seeker clear with second when holding on here a fortnight ago; 8lb rise now

runners.name: Marmeladova
runners.spotlight: Added to her Ballinrobe maiden win when landing a 1m2f handicap here last month off 75; both runs since have been disappointing however, getting worked up beforehand at the Curragh and never landing a blow upped to 1m4f at Tramore five days ago; back down in trip here.
runners.comment: Needs to bounce back from two disappointing runs and drops in trip

runners.name: Duchess Of Kenli
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to the yard's Group 3 winner at 7.5f Princess Child; debuted on AW in December and reappeared much improved to land Gowran fillies' maiden last month, plenty green but picking up well to win going away over 1m; likely has more to offer (Group-entered) and could well be up to making an impact off this opening mark.
runners.comment: Cosy Gowran maiden winner could well be up to making an impact off this opening mark

runners.name: Thrifty Of Digby
runners.spotlight: Front-runner's five wins include back-to-back successes earlier in the summer at Roscommon and Gowran; good run at former venue back at 7f on latest off this mark; should make a bold bid again.
runners.comment: Front-runner should make another bold bid

runners.name: Glory To Be
runners.spotlight: Dual handicap winner over 7f this year, here on soft ground in April and on good ground at Fairyhouse last month; stiff task back in trip in Scurry Handicap latest; only second attempt at 1m now.
runners.comment: Wins have been at 7f, up in trip and likely stronger stayers

runners.name: Minella Buoy
runners.spotlight: Has left moderate Flat form behind with runner-up finishes in two starts over hurdles; beaten a neck over C&D in July but needs to settle better on the basis of his 5.5l defeat at Ballinrobe last time; best hurdles form on offer here but vulnerable to one more talented coming off the Flat.
runners.comment: Brings best hurdles form courtesy of runner-up finishes in both starts

runners.name: Misty Cove
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; won a Sligo Flat handicap off 71 in May but was 21l behind Harmani next time; just okay on C&D hurdles debut here and tailed off back on Flat at Galway last time; others have more compelling claims; new headgear.
runners.comment: Flat h'cap winner off 71 was just okay on C&D hurdles bow; tailed off on Flat latest

runners.name: Harmani
runners.spotlight: Emphatically won a Down Royal handicap for Ger Lyons in May (1m3f, good); okay efforts in three runs since leave him with the top Flat rating in this field of 82 after eight starts; obvious danger to all provided he takes to this discipline.
runners.comment: 1-8 on Flat and has top rating in field of 82; obvious danger provided he takes to jumping

runners.name: Sea Of Dubka
runners.spotlight: Easily won her seventh Flat start in a Down Royal handicap off 61 last time (1m5f, good); brings that positive form to hurdles now and should go well.
runners.comment: Easily won her seventh Flat start off 61 last time; brings that form to hurdles now
runners.owner: Anthony Head & Stephen E McCarthy & Mrs Paul Shanahan

runners.name: Guildhall Graduate
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; rated 54 on Flat after no wins from nine starts; ran his best race at this track last month when fourth; others preferred on hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Is 0-9 on Flat and rated 54 in that sphere; others preferred on hurdling debut

runners.name: Chairmanforlife
runners.spotlight: Best of three Flat runs came at Ballinrobe in May when an 11l fourth; trainer reported he scoped dirty post-race when tailed off at Galway last time; others preferred unless market support arrives for his hurdles bow.
runners.comment: Decent fourth on second Flat start and excuses last time; check market for hurdles bow

runners.name: Another Day Done
runners.spotlight: Showed good improvement for the addition of a visor at Dundalk in January when easily winning off 63 over 1m for former trainer Joseph O'Brien; okay efforts back there and at Leopardstown after that, but beaten 10.5l behind Harmani at Down Royal when last seen in May; Flat rating of 73 puts him in the mix on hurdling/stable debut.
runners.comment: Easy AW winner in January; Flat rating of 73 gives him a shot on hurdling/stable debut

runners.name: Divelment
runners.spotlight: Winless from 10 Flat starts and hasn't looked like the breakthrough was close in two recent starts over hurdles.
runners.comment: 0-10 on Flat and hasn't looked like the breakthrough was close in two starts over hurdles

runners.name: Manntari
runners.spotlight: Tailed off here on Flat debut; hard to fancy after that.
runners.comment: Tailed off here on Flat debut; hard to fancy after that.

runners.name: Camp Verde
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at Ballinrobe on his debut in a similar contest ten days ago (2m1f, good, 100-1); unlikely.
runners.comment: Tailed off on debut last month in similar contest at 100-1; unlikely

runners.name: Connor Of Mali
runners.spotlight: Massive prices and ran like it in three starts over hurdles this summer; similar story likely.
runners.comment: Massive prices and ran like it in three starts over hurdles; similar story likely

runners.name: Eye Contact
runners.spotlight: Is 0-6 over hurdles but has taken the runner-up spot in his last two runs, in a Ballinrobe handicap off 100 (2m2f, good) and in a Cork maiden earlier this month (2m2f, good); 1lb wrong here but he has found some consistency.
runners.comment: 0-6 over hurdles but runner-up last twice; 1lb wrong but has found some consistency

runners.name: Hi Ho Idaho
runners.spotlight: Placed twice in points before placing in his opening two starts over hurdles; made the breakthrough in a 2m4f maiden hurdle here last time; shaped like he wanted further that day, so this drop back in trip may not help him on handicap bow.
runners.comment: Opened his account over 2m4f here last time; drop in trip not sure to suit on h'cap bow

runners.name: Gino Bella
runners.spotlight: Chasing three wins in a row following dual victories at Cork over 2m1f on good ground following the application of a hood; up 8lb more but should be on the premises.
runners.comment: Chasing three in a row following dual victories at Cork; up 8lb more but can go well

runners.name: Fiveonefive
runners.spotlight: Won a valuable handicap hurdle at Galway last time (2m1f, good to yielding), under a good ride by today's jockey; that was a sixth hurdles win but none of those has ever come off a mark this high; not a surefire candidate to follow up.
runners.comment: Valuable Galway handicap winner last time; none of his six wins came off mark this high

runners.name: Fast Felix
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back hurdle races in August/September on good ground (including C&D maiden hurdle); creditable C&D fourth on seasonal return in May off 1lb higher but below that at Listowel next time (2m, yielding); okay fourth of seven on chasing debut here last time; remains 5lb higher than his last win.
runners.comment: Back-to-back winner last summer inc' C&D; okay here on return but well beaten since

runners.name: Lord Ffrench
runners.spotlight: Has lost way since winning a 2m5f maiden hurdle at Sligo in August last year; tongue-tie added to cheekpieces but current form a concern.
runners.comment: Lost way since winning a 2m5f maiden hurdle at Sligo last year; tongue tie is new

runners.name: Moylussa
runners.spotlight: Won a Tipperary maiden hurdle in 2024 (2m1f, soft); creditable third at Ballinrobe in May (2m, good) off 2lb lower and okay effort on chasing debut at Roscommon last time when a distant third; place chance.
runners.comment: Third off 107 in May and okay effort over fences latest; place chance

runners.name: Autumn Twist
runners.spotlight: Flat winner; dual victories over hurdles include a C&D win; just 0.5l behind subsequent Galway Hurdle winner Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown last month (2m1f, good), winner now rated 14lb higher; not a bad effort on the Flat at Galway last time (1m4f, yielding to soft); interesting.
runners.comment: Just 0.5l behind subsequent Galway Hurdle winner (now 14lb higher) last month; interesting

runners.name: Black Bamboo
runners.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner was out of form last season, beaten 27l+ in three starts over hurdles; hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Bumper/hurdle winner was out of form in three starts last season; hard to recommend

runners.name: Feud
runners.spotlight: Maiden/novice wins during the summer of 2024; mostly disappointing since then, fell at Thurles when last seen in January; makes stable debut.
runners.comment: M'den/novice wins in 2024 but mostly disappointing since; fell when last seen in Jan'

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Hurdle

runners.name: Pets Georgina
runners.spotlight: Followed up a Sligo bumper success by easily landing a C&D mares' maiden hurdle; too keen at Kilbeggan last time when well beaten upped to 3m1f in a conditions hurdle; prior to that she looked like a mare on the improve and foolish to discount.
runners.comment: Looked like an improving mare when winning a bumper and C&D m'den hurdle; too keen latest

runners.name: Diamond Du Berlais
runners.spotlight: Solid placed graded form in France on testing ground; shed the maiden tag for this stable at Ludlow in February (2m5f, soft); decent effort on good ground in the mares' novice hurdle at Cheltenham but was below best at Punchestown next time; creditable effort over 2m5f here last time, and extra trip should suit; well treated at weights here and big chance.
runners.comment: M'den hurdle winner has run well at Graded level; well treated at weights; big chance

runners.name: Brother Walfrid
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; second in a Fairyhouse maiden hurdle on stable debut in April before a lesser bumper run; was happier back over obstacles when winning a 2m3f Punchestown maiden hurdle in June; must bounce back from a disappointing Galway (2m5f, good) effort last month, but Kennedy stays loyal.
runners.comment: M'den hurdle winner in June must bounce back from poor Galway run but Kennedy stays loyal

runners.name: Loch Cuan
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; readily justified favouritism to get off the mark at the fourth time of asking in a 2m6f Cartmel maiden hurdle in May and was found a good opportunity to follow up in a novice contest back at Cartmel, where he duly did by 20l; the fact Kennedy rides Brother Walfrid is off-putting.
runners.comment: Won Cartmel m'den hurdle in May and easily followed up there latest; Kennedy rides another

runners.name: Local News
runners.spotlight: Belied odds of 100-1 to make a winning start in a 2m3f mares' maiden hurdle at Cork; proved it wasn't a fluke when a neck in front of Pets Georgina at Kilbeggan to retain unbeaten record (3m, good to yielding); these are deeper waters so must improve.
runners.comment: 100-1 winner on debut and followed up in a novice next time; these are deeper waters

runners.name: Don Jefe
runners.spotlight: Fairyhouse maiden hurdle winner was pulled up on handicap debut off a mark of 113 in April; looks vulnerable at this level.
runners.comment: M'den hurdle winner was PU off 113 in April; looks vulnerable at this level

runners.name: Affinity Rock
runners.spotlight: Won a 2m6f maiden hurdle at this track last year before a poor run at Galway; posted solid efforts in both chase runs earlier this year, including back here; rated 124 and should go well getting the 7lb mares' allowance.
runners.comment: Course hurdle winner; solid efforts both chase runs; go well getting the 7lb sex allowance

runners.name: Lemmy Caution
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; point winner got off the mark over hurdles at Punchestown (3m) in May and posted decent runs in novice races twice since; one to consider on chasing debut with cheekpieces retained.
runners.comment: Decent runs in novice races last twice; considered on chase bow with cheekpieces retained

runners.name: Ballystone
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner up to 3m and is rated 125 in that sphere; made a sound chasing debut at Galway after 92 days away and has to be considered with improvement to come from that.
runners.comment: Sound chasing debut at Galway and has to be considered with improvement to come from that

runners.name: Fort Dino
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles in France on his second start but was well beaten on stable debut in a competitive Punchestown novice hurdle; quickly sent over fences but can't be ruled out; the market might guide.
runners.comment: Well beaten on stable debut in a Punchestown novice hurdle; quickly sent over fences

runners.name: Heroes Rise
runners.spotlight: One of two runners for yard; point and maiden hurdle winner is rated 117 in the latter sphere; fine second on chasing debut to a useful rival last year but has a long absence to overcome; the market might indicate level of readiness.
runners.comment: Second on chasing debut to a useful rival last year but has a long absence to overcome

runners.name: Where's My Jet
runners.spotlight: One of his two hurdle wins came at this track in 2024; however, has been mostly regressive over fences since last autumn and has to improve plenty on his recent poor recent form.
runners.comment: Some good chase runs in defeat but has to improve plenty on his recent poor  form

runners.name: Themanintheanorak
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner got off the mark over hurdles in a Fairyhouse handicap in February; found life tougher off higher marks and was well beaten on chasing debut at Galway; others preferred.
runners.comment: Found life tough over hurdles lately; well beaten on chase bow at Galway; others preferred

runners.name: Happy Me
runners.spotlight: Maiden is rated 100 over hurdles and was well beaten on chasing debut at Tramore a week ago; cheekpieces added but not easy to fancy.
runners.comment: Well beaten on chase debut at Tramore a week ago; cheekpieces added but not easy to fancy

runners.name: Cullenwaine
runners.spotlight: Modest strike rate of 2-22 over fences but was on a real going day over C&D last time, blowing the field apart by 15l (good to yielding); up 9lb for that, but if he's in the same form he has a huge chance; overall record suggests that's no sure thing though.
runners.comment: Blew the field apart here latest; up 9lb for that but 2-22 strike rate more concerning

runners.name: Mount Shenshan
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler is 0-12 over fences; ran okay in handicap chases at Clonmel and Wexford over 2m7f/3m2f earlier this year; well beaten over 2m2f at Galway last time (good); may want it softer.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler is 0-12 over fences; well beaten over 2m2f at Galway latest

runners.name: Smallcraftwarning
runners.spotlight: Is 1-13 over fences with the win coming over C&D last summer off 91 (yielding to soft); hard to predict this term with some okay runs in defeat interspersed with poor efforts; his run at Galway was one of the latter when tailed off over fences but not a bad effort over hurdles here on penultimate; others preferred.
runners.comment: Won off 91 here last summer; hard to predict this term, tailed off latest

runners.name: Tropical Image
runners.spotlight: Fine run in a 2m3f Listowel beginners' on penultimate when a close runner-up; didn't back it up over C&D last time when beaten 26l; 1lb drop not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Fine run in a beginners' on penultimate; beaten 26l over C&D latest; dropped 1lb

runners.name: Malton Groove
runners.spotlight: Maiden in all spheres after 34 starts, but was second at Downpatrick in June off 1lb higher (3m, good); sent off favourite up in grade at Wexford next time (2m7f, good), but was a modest third; well beaten over C&D latest; others preferred.
runners.comment: Maiden after 34 starts; well beaten last two starts but was second at D'patrick in June

runners.name: Oneforgonzo
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner in 2024 on soft added a chase win over an extended 2m4f here in May (good to yielding) off 94; hasn't looked like winning in three runs since (one over hurdles) and was tailed off over fences at Wexford last time in an eight-runner event (2m3f, good); hopes rest on the fact he drops back into same class for first time that saw him win here in May.
runners.comment: Chase winner here in May off 94 has been poor since; drops back down in grade now, though

runners.name: Western Model
runners.spotlight: Doubled his hurdles tally when successful by a neck at Roscommon last month (3m, good); rated 3lb below that winning mark over fences and he has placed on a couple of occasions from nine chase starts; one of the likelier candidates.
runners.comment: Rated 3lb lower compared to hurdles win last time; placed form from nine chase starts

runners.name: Ladies Well
runners.spotlight: Hurdle winner at Ballinrobe in 2025 got off the mark over fences over C&D last month in ready fashion (good to yielding); raised 8lb but was best of the rest when chasing home an easy winner at Roscommon last time (2m6f, soft); up 1lb more but should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Off the mark over fences over C&D last month; good second off revised mark latest

runners.name: Kilkee Bay
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough when winning a Roscommon handicap chase off 90 in June (2m6f, yielding to soft); chased home Cullenwaine over C&D next time when 15l behind; tailed off back at Roscommon last time (3m1f) when didn't appear to stay the trip on soft ground.
runners.comment: Won off 90 in June; 15l behind Cullenwaine over C&D next time; tailed off latest
runners.owner: Aiden Larkin & John Larkin & Paudie Dowling & Kenneth Fox

runners.name: Je Suis
runners.spotlight: Point winner whose best run came at Sligo in June when beaten 3.5l into third in extended 3m1f hurdle; not at same level in two subsequent outings over hurdles; back over fences now, but previous five starts in this sphere were moderate; blinkers on.
runners.comment: Moderate in five previous runs over fences; poor last twice over hurdles

runners.name: Wakey Wakey Man
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in both his points and the same story on sole chase start under rules in a beginners' at Tramore in October (2m5f, yielding); 0-12 over hurdles but has some placed form this season.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in both points and sole chase run; placed over hurdles this year

runners.name: Walk Away Harry
runners.spotlight: His best hurdles form for Charles Byrnes seems long gone and he's now regressive; 12l behind Tropical Image in a six-runner 2m3f Listowel beginners' chase last time.
runners.comment: Looks regressive; 12l behind Tropical Image in a beginners' last time

runners.name: King Ferdinand
runners.spotlight: Veteran hasn't won since August 2024; tailed off here in July, a run sandwiched between two pulled-up finishes; new headgear not enough to tempt now back over fences.
runners.comment: Pulled up twice and tailed off in three runs over hurdles this term; unlikely

runners.name: Burru
runners.spotlight: Hasn't run badly at times in six runs over fences, including when fourth of nine in a Tramore beginners' chase last time (2m6f, good); won here over hurdles on seasonal return/stable debut in May (2m4f, good to yielding) off 104; could go well.
runners.comment: Won here over hurdles on stable debut off 104; didn't run badly in a beginners' latest

runners.name: Tippin And Tappin
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back handicap chase winner last summer, the second of those over 2m7f here (yielding to soft) off 92; sent off favourite for the same race last month but weakened quickly and was pulled up; cheekpieces worn that day are now left off, but questions linger.
runners.comment: Dual chase winner last summer inc' here; PU here last time so questions to answer now

runners.name: Toon Town
runners.spotlight: Won a Wexford handicap hurdle for Brendan Walsh in 2024 off 87, and first success since came in a 2m4f Limerick handicap chase in May (good to yielding) off 6lb lower; disappointed as favourite when attempting to take advantage of his lower hurdles mark at Cork last time (2m1f, good); not ruled out now back chasing.
runners.comment: Won at Limerick off 94 but couldn't take advantage of lower hurdles mark latest

runners.name: Ferdia
runners.spotlight: On a long losing run and needs to improve markedly on recent efforts over fences; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: On a long losing run and needs to improve markedly on recent efforts over fences

runners.name: Illtakehimmyself
runners.spotlight: Consistency over hurdles this season was rewarded here last time when gaining a first win (2m5f, good) off 7lb lower; must carry joint top weight on chasing debut but he's in good form.
runners.comment: Consistency over hurdles rewarded here last time with win; chase debut now off top weight

runners.name: Gaelic Des Chastys
runners.spotlight: Consistent gelding; placed on all four starts off a lower mark over hurdles since a handicap chase win off 98 at Listowel in September (2m4f, good to yielding), form has worked out well; back over fences now on his first run since January; never runs a bad race.
runners.comment: Consistent gelding won off 98 at Listowel in September; makes seasonal return
runners.owner: Wise Guys Syndicate/E Munro/Thomas Fitzsimons/Manorplace Ltd

runners.name: Miners Bridge
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle here in 2024; went close to adding to his tally in a Tipperary handicap chase in July last year off 3lb lower (2m1f, yielding); well beaten over hurdles at Cork on return, but has tended to improve with runs in the past.
runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner here in 2024; poor at Cork over hurdles but may improve on that

runners.name: Shannon Bank
runners.spotlight: Bagged a first hurdles win at Listowel in June on her second run for the yard (2m, yielding); hasn't looked as good over fences in two tries to date.
runners.comment: Bagged a first hurdles win in June; hasn't looked as good over fences in two tries

runners.name: Ollie La Ba Ba
runners.spotlight: Best of three chase runs was the first at Kilbeggan last year, when sixth of 13; beaten 24l at Clonmel in October off 1lb higher on handicap chase debut; two starts over hurdles since not too encouraging.
runners.comment: Beaten 24l on h'cap chase debut in Oct'; two hurdle runs since not too encouraging

runners.name: Kings Jet
runners.spotlight: Winning pointer and hunter chaser; unseated on seasonal return at Wexford before tailed off at the Galway festival; positives to take from his runner-up finish in a four-runner Kilbeggan handicap chase last time in first-time cheekpieces (retained).
runners.comment: Winning pointer/hunter chaser; ran best race of season last time when second of four

runners.name: Seeitoldya
runners.spotlight: Safely held at Uttoxeter in a 2m4f handicap chase and a 3m handicap hurdle last month; now 0-10 under rules; others preferred.
runners.comment: Safely held in two British starts last month; now 0-10 under rules; others preferred
runners.owner: Miss Rachel O'Neill & John C Hurley

runners.name: Piccolo Player
runners.spotlight: Hurdle winner has been soundly beaten in three chases but put up respectable runs in beginners' events the last twice behind smart sorts, including over C&D; might not be too far away.
runners.comment: Respectable runs in beginners' events last twice including over C&D; might not be far away

runners.name: Ballybrittas
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark over fences at Wexford last month and a solid effort there since off this mark; needs to find a bit more but shouldn't be far away.
runners.comment: Third at Wexford last time; needs to find a bit more but shouldn't be far away

runners.name: Beauforts Storm
runners.spotlight: Bumper and hurdle winner has run well enough in defeat over fences including a fourth at Wexford last time; should be competitive on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Was fourth at Wexford last time; should be competitive on handicap debut

runners.name: Kilbrin Rocco
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner won at Tramore in April and was second to Crowsatedappletart at Wexford in May; got badly hampered so ran respectably at Galway last time; capable of being involved.
runners.comment: Got badly hampered so ran respectably at Galway last time; capable of being involved

runners.name: Crowsatedappletart
runners.spotlight: Five-time chase winner is now off a career-high mark following his win at Wexford in May; was poor over hurdles recently at Cork, but can be expected to do better now back over fences; a player.
runners.comment: Poor over hurdles recently but can be expected to do better now back over fences; a player

runners.name: Costacurta
runners.spotlight: A wide-margin 2m4f Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner last year but didn't really go on from that over hurdles; similar efforts in defeat in three chase starts, but has to find more dropping down in trip.
runners.comment: Similar efforts in defeat in three chase starts but has to find more dropping down in trip

runners.name: Femme Magnifique
runners.spotlight: Has hit form back on good ground since switched to this yard, winning chases at Tramore and a career-best when winning over C&D last time; got a 9lb hike for that, but has to be on the short-list.
runners.comment: Got a 9lb hike for winning well over C&D last time but has to be on the short-list

runners.name: Stuntman Steve
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner lost his form over fences (unlucky twice too) earlier this year but posted a solid hurdle effort at Bellewstown last time behind the Galway Hurdle winner; the blinkers worn then are retained and should go well for his in-form yard.
runners.comment: Solid hurdle effort at Bellewstown last time behind the Galway Hurdle winner; go well

runners.name: War Correspondent
runners.spotlight: Flat, hurdle and chase winner but his win record in only 3-49 under rules; below form over fences at Galway last time, but would have a chance on his earlier fourth to Crowsatedappletart at Wexford in May.
runners.comment: Below-par last time but has a chance on his fourth to Crowsatedappletart at Wexford in May

races.race_name: Peadar's Pub Glenbeigh INH Flat Race

runners.name: Iron Sword
runners.spotlight: Posted similar efforts in defeat in bumpers at Punchestown and Roscommon in varying ground conditions; was just in front of Rocky Alfonso on latter occasion but might struggle to uphold that form today.
runners.comment: Just in front of Rocky Alfonso last time but might struggle to uphold that form today

runners.name: Streamhill
runners.spotlight: Some decent efforts in defeat in four bumper starts for this yard and Terence O'Brien; has to build on that to win.
runners.comment: Some decent efforts in defeat in four bumper starts but has to build on that to win

runners.name: Rocky Alfonso
runners.spotlight: Flat-bred gelding ran creditably on bumper debut at Roscommon on ground that would have been soft enough; should have improved since and this livelier ground can suit better, so looks a big player with improvement to come.
runners.comment: Decent debut at Roscommon on ground that would have been soft enough; looks a big player

runners.name: Killeedy
runners.spotlight: Was weak in the market and ran green on debut over C&D last month but still showed potential; the form of that race has taken some knocks, but this mare should be sharper today and still be a big player; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Ran green on debut over C&D; the form of that race has taken some knocks; still a player

runners.name: Con Did It
runners.spotlight: Eleventh foal; half-brother to six winners inc Summit Star (10.6f AW; RPR 97), Daughter In Law (5f 2yo; 86) and Sho Girl (11.5f/1m6f; 78); dam 5f-7f winner (inc 2yo Listed; 111); E5,000 foal is by a jumps sire from a useful Flat damline; worth a market check for an in-form yard.
runners.comment: Is by a jumps sire from a useful Flat damline; worth a market check for an in-form yard

runners.name: Stary Notions
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; half-brother to winners Lady Of Longstone (bumper/2m3f-3m hurdle) and Seangoell (2m6f hurdle); dam bumper and 2m6f/2m7f hurdle winner, half-sister to two smart hurdle/chase winners; has a decent pedigree, but is best watched on debut for future reference.
runners.comment: Has a decent pedigree but is best watched for future reference on debut

runners.name: Walkineezy
runners.spotlight: Posted a promising debut over C&D before being tailed-off in a Galway bumper; has to resume progress in a major way.
runners.comment: Promising debut over C&D before tailed-off in a Galway bumper; has to resume progress
runners.owner: Exors of the Late Michael Moloney

runners.name: Suresuresure
runners.spotlight: Some fair efforts in bumpers and over hurdles, but has to find significant improvement to score.
runners.comment: Some fair efforts in bumpers and over hurdles but has to find significant improvement

runners.name: The Last Line
runners.spotlight: Was just denied by a smart rival in a Cork bumper on debut in 2024 over this trip; has a long absence to overcome, but if he can run even close to that form, then would have a big shout; the market can guide with an inexperienced rider aboard.
runners.comment: Long absence to overcome but if he can run even close to debut form would have a big shout

races.race_name: Racing TV Club Day Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Porcupine Bank
runners.spotlight: Useful Irish 4yo who won twice over 2m in May and was creditable third over that trip in Listed contest at last month's Galway festival (good ground); hiked up in trip here; will be tough to beat if stamina holds out.
runners.comment: Dual hurdle winner; creditable third in 2m Listed race at Galway festival

runners.name: Fine Thing
runners.spotlight: Unable to justify favouritism when only third of six in Market Rasen bumper on rules debut in June but comfortably won Uttoxeter maiden hurdle (2m4f, good) by over 7l last month, and should have a lot more to offer.
runners.comment: Won comfortably on last month's hurdling debut at Uttoxeter; should have more to offer

runners.name: Rebel Tribesman
runners.spotlight: Did not need to improve to justify skinny odds in Warwick maiden (2m3f, good) in May, his third start over hurdles, and was not discredited when second to useful rival at Cartmel (2m6f, good) last month; should have some progress to come in handicaps; likely contender.
runners.comment: Won Warwick maiden in May and should have some progress to come in handicaps; contender

runners.name: Kom Tu Voudras
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage mare with 2-5 strike-rate for current stable, the latter win gained in first-time cheekpieces at Worcester (2m4f, good) in June; weakened into fourth of 16 (behind Torrent) after travelling strongly for a long way at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good) last month but this slightly sharper test might suit her better and she remains of interest.
runners.comment: Weakened into fourth after travelling strongly over 2m7f last time; remains of interest

runners.name: Kittys Glance
runners.spotlight: Won Huntingdon maiden (2m3f, good) in March and was placed in her first two handicaps, latterly when second at Newton Abbot (2m2f, good) last month; could have untapped potential over this new trip; respected.
runners.comment: Placed in both handicaps (2m4f/2m2f); might have untapped potential over this new trip

runners.name: Notnowlinda
runners.spotlight: Seemingly aided by first-time cheekpieces when close third at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good to soft) in March, her fourth run after a long layoff, but was disappointing favourite on next outing; goes without headgear here; needs to up her game.
runners.comment: Ran quite well in first-time cheekpieces in March but safely held since; no headgear today

runners.name: Torrent
runners.spotlight: Seemingly on the downgrade now but stayed on for creditable third of 16 when upped to 2m7f at Uttoxeter (good) last month and gets another chance off the same mark here; a possible.
