runners.comment: Not as good as he was, but kept on for third of 16 when upped to 2m7f last month

races.race_name: Brian And Sheila Vaughan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Magistrato
runners.spotlight: Quirky front-runner who began last season's hat-trick with an emphatic success in this race (good to firm); made low-key reappearance over hurdles in March and has been off for another five months since but not out of this if back in prime form.
runners.comment: Off since low-key hurdle run in March but began last season's hat-trick in this race

runners.name: Crebilly
runners.spotlight: Exploited reduced hurdle mark when winning narrowly over about 2m6f (if additional yardage is included) at Market Rasen (good) in May and remains very well handicapped on older chase form but he's not as good as he was and others have more appealing profiles.
runners.comment: Very useful chaser in his prime; won off reduced hurdle mark in May; others appeal more

runners.name: Captain Cool
runners.spotlight: Progressive 6yo with 3-5 strike-rate over fences, including two 2m1f course wins this season; ran big race when close third behind Sir Tivo here (2m1f, good to firm) last month and could still have a bigger performance in him over this longer trip.
runners.comment: 3-5 over fences; ran big race when third behind Sir Tivo here (2m1f) last month; respected

runners.name: Sir Tivo
runners.spotlight: Front-running veteran who is well suited by good or faster ground and battled well to score over 2m1f here last month, his 12th chase win; not sure to be ideally suited by today's longer trip but no surprise if he makes another bold bid.
runners.comment: Front-running veteran; dug deep here (2m1f) last month, recording his 12th chase win

runners.name: Parisencore
runners.spotlight: Gained both chase wins over 2m4f; bumped into progressive rival when second at Hexham (1m7f, good) two starts ago and travelled well until stamina ebbed away over 3m at Perth last month; remains on a workable mark; can make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Second to progressive rival over 1m7f two runs ago; stretched by 3m last time; a player
runners.owner: Miss D Sellars & Exors Of Mrs Ic Sellars

runners.name: Bagheera Ginge
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who is 2-3 since fitted with a visor this season, with both wins gained over 2m6f here (good to firm); may not have things all his own way today and this drop back in trip is probably not ideal but further progress is not out of the question.
runners.comment: Front-runner; 2-3 since visored this season, gaining both wins over 2m6f here

races.race_name: QuinnBet Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Samuel Spade
runners.spotlight: Five wins over hurdles and opened chasing account over 2m7f at Worcester in June off 5lb lower (under Beau Morgan claiming his 5lb); respectable since on two visits to Uttoxeter, in a Class 2 and last time behind a Skelton improver; good chance.
runners.comment: Worcester winner in June and respectable since on two visits to Uttoxeter

runners.name: Krak
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler in Ireland and runner-up over hurdles on final run for the Twiston-Davies yard; back over fences (0-4) in two runs for Dan Skelton and didn't see either race out with much purpose (2m/2m1f), and those were after a wind operation; reservations for now and returning to further isn't an obvious positive.
runners.comment: Two runs following wind surgery and didn't see either out with any great purpose

runners.name: Dunkerque
runners.spotlight: Won his first three races over fences (2m4f to an extended 2m5f) and, in first-time cheekpieces, ran well enough at Cartmel (2m1f; Krak 15l behind) to believe he's still on a workable mark; hard to knock.
runners.comment: 3-4 over fences; ran well enough at Cartmel to believe he's still on a workable mark

runners.name: Glenmalure Flyer
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish pointer; won comfortably on stable debut at Bangor (3m) and the 18l defeat here was only four days later under a penalty and back over 2m3f; 1lb higher now but good reason to expect much better from her.
runners.comment: Bangor winner at 3m and following defeat was over a shorter trip only four days later

runners.name: Illogical Logic
runners.spotlight: Last season ended on a low note, as he wasn't in much form before pulling up here in April behind Yes And Yes; the cheekpieces returned for his June run and he perhaps went off too hard having been clear at one stage (often front runs); has wellbeing issues to address, but he's on a handy mark and Jack Tudor is back aboard replacing a 7lb claimer (up top last three races).
runners.comment: Wellbeing issues to address but on a good mark and Jack Tudor is back aboard

runners.name: Winning Paddy
runners.spotlight: 3m2f winner at Newton Abbot in June and his next run was over hurdles; latest defeat, back at Newton Abbot over his winning trip, is harder to forgive.
runners.comment: Hasn't kicked on since June's win over 3m2f, with latest effort underwhelming

runners.name: Flashy Boy
runners.spotlight: Limited hurdler; unconvincing point form before finishing tailed off on second run over fences at Newton Abbot (2m5f); he was only 7-2 that day so better was perhaps expected, but he's risky.
runners.comment: Unconvincing point form before finishing tailed off on second run over fences

runners.name: Yes And Yes
runners.spotlight: 3-3 beyond 3m, winning over C&D and then readily defying a 5lb rise at Warwick (3m1f); up another 7lb and has been absent for three months, but clearly a likely contender.
runners.comment: 3-3 beyond 3m and a likely contender despite returning from a three-month absence
runners.owner: David W Jagger & Mrs Belinda Clarke

runners.name: The Kings Soldier
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden under rules; his third on chase debut two runs back was quite remote and then tailed off on his return to hurdles; 3lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: His third on chase debut two runs back was quite remote; since tailed off over hurdles

races.race_name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Berry Edge
runners.spotlight: Came good over hurdles for David Thompson with clear success at Wetherby (2m, soft) in February and was placed off today's mark over that C&D (good to soft) the following month; changed hands for £21,000 in May and was given a wind op soon afterwards; goes without cheekpieces on this debut for Dan Skelton but should be fine on the forecast faster ground; must be considered.
runners.comment: In good form when last seen in February/March and has since switched to a top stable

runners.name: Diesel Line
runners.spotlight: Yet to hit top gear after three runs this year (suffered heavy fall on penultimate outings) but won twice at Uttoxeter (2m, good) last summer and is back on a good mark now; could have a say.
runners.comment: Yet to hit top gear this season but has slipped to a good mark; could have a say

runners.name: Jet Patrol
runners.spotlight: Won this race on stable debut a year ago (good to firm) and was also on target at Plumpton (2m, good) last September; returned from break with two respectable runs last month and, with Sean Bowen booked again, features prominently in calculations.
runners.comment: Won this race on stable debut a year ago; returns here after two respectable runs in July

runners.name: Northern Rose
runners.spotlight: Posted several good efforts in defeat over C&D before finally making her breakthrough at Uttoxeter (2m, good) last month, her 27th start over hurdles; might be a shade vulnerable after recent 4lb rise but ought to give another good account.
runners.comment: Finally made her breakthrough at Uttoxeter last month; also suited by this C&D

runners.name: Reteti
runners.spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles but runner-up twice over C&D on fast ground since returning from a break in May; won't mind if there's rain about and ought to be right in the thick of things again.
runners.comment: Second twice over C&D on fast ground this season; likely contender again

runners.name: Mayday Games
runners.spotlight: Opened account over C&D (good) on stable debut in June, readily drawing 7l clear; might still have more to offer for his new trainer but was safely held when favourite at Uttoxeter last month; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Ready C&D winner on stable debut in June; held since but still considered

runners.name: Versatile
runners.spotlight: 1-25 on the Flat; kept on for third on handicap hurdle debut at Southwell (2m, good) in June but two lesser efforts have followed and it's questionable whether the refitted cheekpieces will make the necessary difference.
runners.comment: Placed on handicap debut in June but two lesser efforts have followed

runners.name: Eyeeye
runners.spotlight: Predictably struggled in good-quality Irish Flat maiden last month and is now 0-30 under all codes; has much more realistic assignment now back in a low-grade handicap hurdle for new stable but still makes only limited appeal.
runners.comment: 0-30 under all codes and makes limited appeal on stable debut

runners.name: Clever Relation
runners.spotlight: No match for comfortable winner when second of five on stable/handicap debut at Uttoxeter (2m, good; reportedly made respiratory noise) in June but that was his first run for 462 days and he now has a tongue-tie fitted; improvement possible.
runners.comment: Well held when second of five on stable/handicap debut but that came after a long layoff

runners.name: Angel Of My Dreams
runners.spotlight: Showed no significant promise in three novice/maiden hurdles here (2m-2m2f) in June/July and is 8lb out of the weights for this handicap debut; significant improvement required.
runners.comment: Yet to show any significant promise over hurdles and is 8lb wrong for this handicap debut

runners.name: Glance At Me
runners.spotlight: Scored off 4lb higher at Fakenham (2m, good) in April 2024 but absent since pulled up twice the following June; had wind op in June and is fitted with first-time hood/tongue-tie for this reappearance; others have much less to prove.
runners.comment: Absent since pulled up twice in June 2024; returns with new headgear tried

runners.name: Lord Cauvelliere
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all five hurdling starts but wasn't beaten far in his two handicaps in the spring (2m/2m1f, good) and now returns to this track for first time since comfortably winning a bumper last spring; interesting
runners.comment: Course bumper winner; not beaten far in first two handicaps; interesting back here

runners.name: Fleur De Mer
runners.spotlight: Dual winner although the latest of them came here (1m2f) in 2023; regularly in the frame, however, including when fourth at Carlisle (1m3f) last month and third over 2m at Catterick (also good to firm) a fortnight ago; capable of having a say.
runners.comment: Course winner who's regularly in the frame; capable of having a say
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs G F Hall Racing

runners.name: Jedhi Knight
runners.spotlight: First two Flat runs for this yard were fairly encouraging, beaten 3l over C&D in June and second of 11 at Pontefract (1m4f, good) the following month; lacked the gears at Musselburgh last time but he's still of some interest.
runners.comment: First two Flat runs for this yard were fairly encouraging; of some interest

runners.name: Forever Perfect
runners.spotlight: In good form on AW in the spring and she won at Wolverhampton (1m4f, Tapeta) in April; beaten 14l on turf in June and 23l on her return to AW three weeks ago, however; needs to get back on track but that's not beyond the realms.
runners.comment: In good form on AW in the spring; beaten 23l on her comeback but not ruled out

runners.name: Muhib
runners.spotlight: 28-race maiden but he has been running with credit, finishing in the frame on his last eight starts; acts on AW and he makes more appeal than some.
runners.comment: 28-race maiden but he has been running with credit; makes more appeal than some

runners.name: Billy Bathgate
runners.spotlight: His six wins, including two here, have all been gained over further; won at Redcar (2m) on his penultimate start and his latest fifth over 1m6f wasn't a bad effort; this is winnable if he handles the drop back in trip.
runners.comment: Six wins, including two here, have all been over further; possibilities if handling 1m4f

runners.name: Wave Power
runners.spotlight: He has been beaten increasingly big margins in three handicaps; new cheekpieces have some work to do.
runners.comment: He has been beaten increasingly big margins in three handicaps; cheekpieces given a go

runners.name: Hickton
runners.spotlight: All three wins since September and he opened his AW account at Southwell (1m4f, Tapeta) in October; posted a career best when scoring at that track (1m6f) in April but he made no impact in two starts the following month; returns from three-month break.
runners.comment: Career best (1m6f) in April but no impact in two starts since; returns from 90-day break

runners.name: Gemical
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; both 1m4f runs in May were respectable and she may not have been suited by the soft ground when well beaten over 1m6f in June; has her second go on AW from a reduced mark and it's still relatively early days.
runners.comment: Both 1m4f runs in May were respectable; soft-ground excuse latest; still fairly early days
runners.owner: G C Gale & Stuart Brown & Diane Stewart

runners.name: Brunello Breeze
runners.spotlight: All three wins have come here (1m2f-1m4f); yet to recapture his best for this yard and he looked to wonder whether he fancied leaving the stalls on his return from 146-day break at Catterick a fortnight ago.
runners.comment: All three wins here (1m2f-1m4f); looked to think about refusing on his comeback last time

runners.name: Romeo's Guardian
runners.spotlight: He had three qualifying runs over 6f in the spring before being gelded; made handicap debut over 1m2f at Ayr last month but he was uneasy in the market and never threatened; first-time cheekpieces worn that day are swapped for blinkers; still early days ahead of this further step up in trip.
runners.comment: Uneasy in the market and no threat on h'cap debut over 1m2f at Ayr last month; blinkers on

runners.name: Galahad Threepwood
runners.spotlight: Two Lingfield AW wins (1m4f) for Mick Channon in 2021 and he also nabbed a handicap hurdle for Ben Pauling in 2023; some fair runs without winning for this yard but he has not been at his best since returning from a 406-day absence this season; career-low mark and he lost a shoe last time so worth a market check.
runners.comment: Hasn't been at best since returning from a 406-day absence this season; career-low mark

runners.name: Carwyn
runners.spotlight: Yet to click for this yard and was 18l adrift on his AW debut at Southwell (1m3f) last month; reduced mark so worth a market check.
runners.comment: Yet to click for this yard; 18l adrift on AW debut last month; reduced mark

runners.name: Star Of Markinch
runners.spotlight: 43-race maiden who is 3lb out of the handicap.
runners.comment: 43-race maiden who is 3lb out of the handicap

runners.name: Niffler
runners.spotlight: In typical yard style he cracked off three quick qualifying runs (7f-1m); now enters handicaps up sharply in trip in a race that's begging to be won; betting should be very informative.
runners.comment: Three quick qualifying runs; enters handicaps up sharply in trip; betting a firm guide

races.race_name: Trusted Betting Site Reviews Gambling.com Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (GBB)

runners.name: Queen's Hame
runners.spotlight: Drops back from 1m; too free when a beaten favourite on debut but made no mistake with a comfortable 4l success at Nottingham (again market leader) and she's looking a good prospect.
runners.comment: Did it comfortably at Nottingham; that was over an extended 1m; promising

runners.name: Star Of Commala
runners.spotlight: In rear throughout on her debut at Wolverhampton (6f) but there was no fluke about her 125-1 success there over 7f as she travelled well before clinging on to repel a subsequent Newmarket winner; has to be taken seriously; Molly Keegan-Price was aboard that day.
runners.comment: 125-1 winner last time but no fluke about it and the second has won since

runners.name: Roccapina
runners.spotlight: Changed yards after debut and was always behind in a small field at Ripon last month.
runners.comment: Changed yards after debut and was always behind in a small field at Ripon last month

runners.name: Miss Veronika
runners.spotlight: Had wind surgery prior to finishing comfortably held in two bumpers.
runners.comment: Had wind surgery prior to finishing comfortably held in two bumpers

runners.name: Janora
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to winners Archduke Ferdinand (6f-1m; RPR 94) and Lorna B (6f; 86); dam 1m/9.4f winner (81); would need to see market confidence behind her.
runners.comment: Half-sister to winners Archduke Ferdinand (6f-1m; RPR 94) and Lorna B (6f; 86)

runners.name: Mystic Wave
runners.spotlight: 250-1 when completely tailed off over this trip at Ripon three weeks ago.
runners.comment: 250-1 when completely tailed off over this trip at Ripon three weeks ago

runners.name: Suntino Lady
runners.spotlight: Fourth of eight behind a well-bred winner at Redcar (7f) and she was getting the hang of things late on (beaten just under 8l); improvement seems likely.
runners.comment: Beaten a shade under 8l at Redcar (7f) and was getting the hang of things late on

runners.name: Bowie Lass
runners.spotlight: Out of a Listed 6f winner but has shown pretty much nothing in two 7f races at Redcar.
runners.comment: Out of a Listed 6f winner but has shown pretty much nothing in two 7f races at Redcar

runners.name: Navertity
runners.spotlight: Ran to a modest level in one AW run over 6f for Harry Charlton and sold on for 5,500gns.
runners.comment: Ran to a modest level in one AW run over 6f for Harry Charlton and sold on for 5,500gns

races.race_name: Compare Betting Sites At gambling.com Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Spirited Gesture
runners.spotlight: By Kingman and a sister to smart winners Calyx and Coppice; noticeably strong in the market when defying inexperience (drifted left) in a good-looking 7f novice on the July course at Newmarket, where she travelled well and found plenty; entered in the Group 2 Rockfel and Group 1 Fillies' Mile; she could well be destined for that level.
runners.comment: 6-4 and looked potentially high class in winning on her debut at Newmarket

runners.name: Angel In My Heart
runners.spotlight: Showed a bit over 5f and then justified favouritism over 6f at Pontefract; however, that was by a narrow margin and the form has taken some knocks.
runners.comment: Only won narrowly at Pontefract and the form has taken some knocks

runners.name: Rubyroo
runners.spotlight: 140,000gns yearling; fourth foal; sister to 5f 2yo winner Supreme Diamond (RPR 66) and half-sister to 6f winner Sayidah Dariyan (Group 3; 115); dam French 7f winner; could be interesting, all the more so if strong in the betting.
runners.comment: 140,000gns yearling; fourth foal; sister to 5f 2yo winner Supreme Diamond (RPR 66)

runners.name: One Shot Kodi
runners.spotlight: In the process of showing more when hampered over 6f here last time out; capable of better but extremely hard to envisage her coping with Spirited Gesture.
runners.comment: In the process of showing more when hampered over 6f here last time out

runners.name: Ortanique
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to winners Royal Favour (UAE 9.5f dirt; RPR 96) and Nochebuena (1m4f; 93); dam Peruvian 1m/1m2f Group 1 winner, half-sister to Peruvian champion grass horse More Than Words; the sire instils some speed into the pedigree; the market should be enlightening.
runners.comment: Half-sister to winners Royal Favour (UAE 9.5f dirt; RPR 96) and Nochebuena (1m4f; 93)

runners.name: All I Know
runners.spotlight: Pinatubo filly who cost 40,000gns as a yearling; eleventh foal; half-sister to seven winners including Bullingdon (7f turf 2yo/1m AW; RPR 94), Garrick (1m AW; 92), Chess Grand Master (bumper and 1m4f/2m AW Flat; 91) and Ginger Fox (6f/7f; 89); dam 5f 2yo and 7f Group 3 winner (106); positive pedigree.
runners.comment: Pinatubo filly who cost 40,000gns as a yearling and is a half-sister to seven winners

runners.name: Noccalula Falls
runners.spotlight: Beaten in the region of 12l in a 6f novice and 5f maiden; one for handicaps.
runners.comment: Beaten in the region of 12l in a 6f novice and 5f maiden; one for handicaps

runners.name: Texting
runners.spotlight: Finished midfield at Ripon (6f), beaten just over 7l at odds of 66-1; should win races in time but this is highly unlikely to be one of those.
runners.comment: Finished midfield at Ripon (6f), beaten just over 7l at odds of 66-1

races.race_name: Harry Potter Droneart Show Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Star People
runners.spotlight: Neck second in a match at Ayr (6f, good to firm) last month on first run since being gelded and close third of seven on subsequent nursery debut at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) where he showed bright pace; this first attempt at 5f might be a good move; could be a contender in first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Close third over 6f on nursery debut and this first attempt at 5f might be a good move

runners.name: May Bee In Profit
runners.spotlight: Improving profile in the spring, winning a novice at Carlisle (5f, good) in May on her fourth start; tailed off at 33-1 on nursery debut at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago following a two-month break but she's back in calmer waters today and is not written off.
runners.comment: Tailed off in Glorious Goodwood nursery but back in calmer waters here and not written off

runners.name: Social Spirit
runners.spotlight: Promising third on debut at Doncaster in May and he's back at 5f for the first time since; however, his form has gone the wrong way and he's been soundly beaten over 6f in his two nurseries; others have less to prove.
runners.comment: Promising third on debut at Doncaster in May but his form has gone the wrong way since

runners.name: This Moment
runners.spotlight: Went close in two of his three novice races (6f, good) and not beaten far in fourth of five on recent nursery debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm), where shaping as though 5f would be worth exploring; might be in the mix.
runners.comment: Close fourth of five over 6f at Windsor on nursery debut and 5f might be worth exploring
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Casino Star
runners.spotlight: Went close behind the subsequent Molecomb third in Hamilton maiden (5f, good) last month on third start; beaten 3l when third of five in nursery there (5f, good) subsequently but the first-time cheekpieces might give him a boost and he remains one to be interested in for his top yard.
runners.comment: 3l third of five on nursery debut but cheekpieces added & remains one to be interested in

runners.name: Influencer Man
runners.spotlight: He's improved with each of his three starts and justified favouritism on his nursery debut at Carlisle (5f, good) last Tuesday; the clear runner-up has since gone one better in good style and a 6lb penalty may not stop this gelding on his first AW start, for which cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: Won on nursery debut at Carlisle last Tuesday & form franked by the runner-up; 5lb penalty

runners.name: Buzz Box
runners.spotlight: Three course wins for Bryan Smart; yet to shine for his current trainer but he is edging down the weights and he shouldn't be underestimated.
runners.comment: Three course wins for B Smart; not shone this year but slipped to a dangerous mark

runners.name: Copper Knight
runners.spotlight: Grand servant to connections and he was recording the 19th win of his long career when successful at Beverley (5f, good to soft) in May; four subsequent defeats have seen him slip to a mark 2lb lower than for that win; has won over C&D but likely vulnerable to younger rivals.
runners.comment: On a good mark but this fine veteran could prove vulnerable to younger legs

runners.name: Little Mi Mi
runners.spotlight: Five wins this year, three of them over C&D; took her form to a new level when winning at Hamilton 19 days ago but a 6lb rise and stronger opposition could find her out today.
runners.comment: Much improved this year, winning 5 times, but this is a rise in class & others appeal more
runners.owner: N Irving, F Steele & I Jardine

runners.name: True Promise
runners.spotlight: Better on AW than turf so two defeats on the grass aren't especially damaging to his claims here; won easily at Wolverhampton (5f) on his most recent start and he is respected back on Tapeta.
runners.comment: Easy win in last AW run; return to Tapeta a plus; should give his running

runners.name: Azuinthejungle
runners.spotlight: Completed a sprint hat-trick last summer and he has repeated the feat this time around, coming here on the back of wins at Ayr, Beverley and Thirsk; up 4lb as he bids for the four-timer; should be in the thick of it again.
runners.comment: Arrives on the back of a turf hat-trick; effective over C&D; should be involved again
runners.owner: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde

runners.name: Too Much
runners.spotlight: Back to form with a bang when winning a C&D handicap 26 days ago; that was a lowly Class 6 event though and a 7lb rise against deeper opposition looks beyond her.
runners.comment: Easy C&D win last month but up 7lb and two classes; vulnerable

runners.name: Lethal Nymph
runners.spotlight: C&D win off 1lb higher last November; retains all his ability as a 7yo and he is a major player back on Tapeta.
runners.comment: Conditions no problem and he retains a good portion of his ability; high on the list

runners.name: Ice Cold Alex
runners.spotlight: A fair 5f juvenile winner; back to form with fourth in 5f Beverley handicap in May and didn't enjoy a smooth run (also stumbled 1f out) when sixth of seven at Pontefract (5f) last time; returns from a break in a competitive race and others may have his measure.
runners.comment: 5f win as a 2yo; retains ability but he returns from a 79-day break in a competitive race

runners.name: Changeofmind
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing run at Pontefract (5f, good to soft) in May; not so good since and others are more persuasive ahead of his AW debut.
runners.comment: Ended losing run at Pontefract in May; not so good since; AW debut

runners.name: Star Material
runners.spotlight: Often slowly away but his refusal to race at Redcar last month was a new low; blinkers tried there are quickly dispensed with; hard to recommend after latest display.
runners.comment: Has ability but he refused to race last month and can't be backed after that

runners.name: Castan
runners.spotlight: Multiple C&D winner; ran his best race for some time when third of ten at Beverley last week; major player back on AW.
runners.comment: On a winning mark, ran well on turf last week and holds solid claims back on AW

runners.name: Smart Vision
runners.spotlight: Stable's quiet year has seen him plummet down the weights and he is now on an extremely tempting mark; didn't run badly at Sandown four weeks ago and he has run well in all three visits to Newcastle; shortlisted.
runners.comment: On a dangerous mark and latest run was a bit more like it; good course form; shortlisted

runners.name: Duran
runners.spotlight: Made a promising return to action at Beverley (5f, good to soft) in April but two runs since have been underwhelming; on a dangerous mark and there is encouragement for AW on pedigree.
runners.comment: Promising reappearance has been followed by two lesser runs; good mark ahead of AW debut
runners.owner: D Caslin, P Wilcock & M Cantillon

races.race_name: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap

runners.name: Wait For It
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden; in fair form on turf this summer, placed over 6f twice before fair 7f efforts on her last starts; the return to 6f won't hurt and she did run well on AW once when trained in Ireland.
runners.comment: 0-15 but in fair form on turf this summer; return to 6f should suit; handled AW in Ireland

runners.name: Get Up Everybody
runners.spotlight: Exposed maiden who is proving expensive to follow, beaten favourite on his last four starts; running well enough to be right in the picture here though.
runners.comment: 0-15 and proving expensive to follow; still running well enough to come into the reckoning

runners.name: Operation Gimcrack
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins earlier in the year and he was back at his best when second at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) 19 days ago; has his first 6f run since his racecourse debut today but it shouldn't be a problem; high on the list.
runners.comment: Having a rare 6f run but good second at Doncaster last time and remains feasibly weighted

runners.name: Ottawa
runners.spotlight: Consistency wasn't his strong suit for his former yard and his recent stable debut was hardly chock full of promise; drops in grade but comes with risks attached.
runners.comment: None too consistent and his recent stable debut was uninspiring; others appeal more

runners.name: Mart
runners.spotlight: Has a course win (5f) amongst his seven wins but the latest was back in May 2025; two respectable turf runs for Des Donovan and he's one to consider.
runners.comment: On a losing run but his two runs for his new stable have been fine; not ruled out

runners.name: Desert Master
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; on a long losing run but there have been enough good runs this year to give him an each-way squeak.
runners.comment: C&D winner; on long losing run but retains sufficient ability to hold each-way claims
runners.owner: John And Tony Jarvis And Partner

runners.name: Gemini Star
runners.spotlight: Modest strike-rate but she ran well on her seasonal and stable debut at Thirsk (6f, good), finishing second of 17; 2lb rise fair enough and she needs serious consideration.
runners.comment: Solid effort at Thirsk on stable/seasonal debut; big player up 2lb

runners.name: Donald
runners.spotlight: The handicapper has been in command this summer and although he didn't run badly at Doncaster 19 days ago, he will need more for the switch to AW.
runners.comment: Dropping down the weights but the switch to AW needs to have a positive effect

runners.name: Newyorkstateofmind
runners.spotlight: Regressive veteran; finished second at Catterick (5f, good) in May but little to celebrate since; vulnerable once more.
runners.comment: Second at Catterick in May but little to celebrate since; vulnerable once more

runners.name: Multaneighttothree
runners.spotlight: Just modest form in three 1m runs here early in the year (flattered by peak RPR in a slowly run race); goes handicapping at a modest level but the drop in trip needs to have a positive effect.
runners.comment: Modest form in three 1m runs here this winter; down in trip for handicap debut

runners.name: Asadjumeirah
runners.spotlight: Hardly prolific but he has six C&D wins on his record, the latest three weeks ago when coming from off the pace to win decisively in 0-50 classified company; this is tougher but we know he's capable when in top form.
runners.comment: Six-time C&D winner, the latest a classified three weeks ago; each-way shout again

runners.name: White Umbrella
runners.spotlight: Four AW wins (all at Wolverhampton) to her name; arrives on the back of a good win at Ayr (6f, good to soft) ten days ago and should be fine at this track; one to consider under her penalty.
runners.comment: Four AW wins at Wolverhampton; scored at Ayr ten days ago; respected under penalty

runners.name: Mount Ruapehu
runners.spotlight: Won three sprint handicaps at Southwell in the spring; form has dipped more recently but he has slipped in the weights and Jack Nicholls takes off a handy 5lb; market instructive.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on spring AW form; return to Class 6 a plus; revival could be imminent

runners.name: Secret Road
runners.spotlight: Eight-time winner; made a winning stable debut for Laura Mongan (1m, AW) in March but that wasn't a springboard to better things; sold for 2,000gns in July; return to 6f should suit on stable debut.
runners.comment: Eight-time winner; sold 2,000gns since latest run; return to sprinting should suit
